bg_paused:
select status from bg_job where account_id = $1::uuid and kind = $2 and status in ('done', 'failed', 'skipped')
     order by created_at desc limit $3
bg_agent_on: select bg_enabled from agent_config where account_id = $1::uuid
bg_enqueue:
insert into bg_job (account_id, kind, day, input)
       select $1::uuid, $2, $3::date, $4::jsonb
       where (select count(*) from bg_job where day = $3::date) < $5
       on conflict (account_id, kind, day) do nothing
       returning id
bg_exists: select 1 from bg_job where account_id = $1::uuid and kind = $2 and day = $3::date
bg_distill_candidates:
with pairs as (
       select n.account_id, n.thread_root_id as root_id, true as has_note
         from thread_note n where n.archived_at is null and n.flag_reason is null
       union
       select distinct m.author_id, coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id), false
         from message m join account a on a.id = m.author_id and a.kind = 'agent'
        where m.deleted_at is null and m.created_at > $1::timestamptz - interval '30 days'
     ), cand as (
       select p.account_id, p.root_id, s.updated_at, bool_or(p.has_note) as has_note
         from pairs p
         join account a on a.id = p.account_id and a.kind = 'agent' and a.deleted_at is null
         join agent_config ac on ac.account_id = a.id and ac.harness = $3
         join thread_status s on s.root_id = p.root_id
         join message rm on rm.id = p.root_id and rm.deleted_at is null and rm.thread_root_id is null
         join channel c on c.id = rm.channel_id
        where s.status = 'done' and s.updated_at < $1::timestamptz
          and ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = p.account_id))
          and not exists (
            select 1 from bg_job j
             where j.account_id = p.account_id and j.kind = 'distill' and j.status = 'done'
               and j.finished_at > s.updated_at and j.input->'threadIds' ? p.root_id::text)
        group by p.account_id, p.root_id, s.updated_at
     )
     select account_id, (array_agg(root_id order by updated_at, root_id))[1:$2] as threads
       from cand
      where has_note
         or exists (select 1 from message h join account ha on ha.id = h.author_id and ha.kind = 'human'
                     where (h.id = cand.root_id or h.thread_root_id = cand.root_id) and h.deleted_at is null and h.kind = 'user')
         or exists (select 1 from message f
                     where (f.id = cand.root_id or f.thread_root_id = cand.root_id) and f.deleted_at is null
                       and f.author_id = cand.account_id and f.meta->>'kind' = 'failure')
      group by account_id
bg_cleanup_candidates:
select a.id as account_id,
            coalesce((select char_length(value) from agent_memory where account_id = a.id and slug = 'core'), 0)::int as core_len,
            (select count(*) from agent_memory where account_id = a.id and archived_at is null)::int as active,
            (select count(*) from agent_memory where account_id = a.id and kind = 'journal' and archived_at is null)::int as journals,
            exists (select 1 from bg_job j where j.account_id = a.id and j.kind = 'cleanup' and j.created_at > $1::timestamptz) as recent
       from account a
      where a.kind = 'agent' and a.deleted_at is null
        -- 실행기가 집는 하네스만 — 다른 하네스는 신호로 지금처럼 정리한다(bgCleanupOn 과 같은 판정).
        and exists (select 1 from agent_config ac where ac.account_id = a.id and ac.harness = $2)
        and exists (select 1 from agent_memory m where m.account_id = a.id)
bg_organize_candidates:
with last as (
       select a.id as account_id,
              (select max(j.created_at) from bg_job j where j.account_id = a.id and j.kind = 'organize') as last_at
         from account a
        where a.kind = 'agent' and a.deleted_at is null
          and exists (select 1 from agent_config ac where ac.account_id = a.id and ac.harness = $2)
          and exists (select 1 from agent_memory m where m.account_id = a.id and m.slug <> 'core')
     )
     select l.account_id, l.last_at,
            -- organize 회차 자신의 쓰기는 세지 않는다 — 세면 정리한 만큼 다음 정리가 앞당겨진다. 마지막 organize 뒤의 그 쓰기만
            -- 뺀다(security n3): 옮겨진 slug 를 나중에 일반 턴이 고친 판은 run_id 가 없어 그대로 센다.
            ((select count(*) from agent_memory m where m.account_id = l.account_id and m.slug <> 'core'
                and m.created_at > coalesce(l.last_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
                and not exists (select 1 from bg_job_change c join bg_job oj on oj.id = c.run_id and oj.kind = 'organize'
                                 where oj.account_id = l.account_id and c.slug = m.slug
                                   and c.created_at > coalesce(l.last_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)))
           + (select count(*) from agent_memory_revision r where r.account_id = l.account_id and r.slug <> 'core'
                and r.replaced_at > coalesce(l.last_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
                and (r.run_id is null or not exists (select 1 from bg_job oj where oj.id = r.run_id and oj.kind = 'organize'))))::int as changes
       from last l
      where l.last_at is null or l.last_at < $1::timestamptz - interval '7 days'
list_delegations_mine:
select g.id, c.name as connector, g.limits, g.delegate_depth as "delegateDepth", g.expires_at as "expiresAt",
            g.write_needs_human_cause as "writeNeedsHumanCause", g.suspend_reason as "suspendReason", g.parent_grant_id is not null as delegated
       from account_grant g join api_connector c on g.scope = 'connector:' || c.id::text
      where g.account_id = $1::uuid and g.capability = 'api.call' order by c.name
list_delegations_given:
select g.id, a.handle as "to", c.name as connector, g.limits, g.delegate_depth as "delegateDepth", g.expires_at as "expiresAt",
            g.suspend_reason as "suspendReason"
       from account_grant g join api_connector c on g.scope = 'connector:' || c.id::text join account a on a.id = g.account_id
      where g.granted_by = $1::uuid and g.parent_grant_id is not null order by c.name, a.handle
list_tool_rules:
select scope, expires_at as "expiresAt",
            exists (
    select 1 from agent_config dc join account da on da.id = dc.account_id join account dp on dp.id = account_grant.granted_by
     where dc.account_id = account_grant.account_id and dp.kind = 'human' and dp.disabled_at is null and dp.deleted_at is null
       and (dc.owner_account_id = dp.id
         or (dc.user_decide and da.disabled_at is null and da.deleted_at is null and dp.role <> 'guest'
             and exists (select 1 from channel dch where dch.id = nullif(split_part(account_grant.scope, ':', 2), '')::uuid and ((dch.kind = 'standard' and dch.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = dch.id and cm_vis.account_id = account_grant.granted_by)))
             and (dc.invoke_scope = 'community'
               or (dc.invoke_scope = 'list' and exists (select 1 from agent_invoker di where di.agent_id = dc.account_id and di.account_id = dp.id))
               or (dc.invoke_scope = 'channel' and exists (select 1 from channel_member dm join channel dmc on dmc.id = dm.channel_id
                     where dm.channel_id = nullif(split_part(account_grant.scope, ':', 2), '')::uuid and dm.account_id = dp.id and dmc.kind <> 'dm')))))) as "mayDecide"
       from account_grant
      where account_id = $1::uuid and capability = 'tool.allow' and left(scope, 5) = 'tool:' and (expires_at is null or expires_at > $2::timestamptz)
      order by scope

repo_grant_for:

       from account_grant
      where account_id = $1::uuid and capability = $5::text and scope = any($2::text[])
        and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())
        and ($4::uuid is null or exists (
    select 1 from agent_config dc join account da on da.id = dc.account_id join account dp on dp.id = account_grant.granted_by
     where dc.account_id = account_grant.account_id and dp.kind = 'human' and dp.disabled_at is null and dp.deleted_at is null
       and (dc.owner_account_id = dp.id
         or (dc.user_decide and da.disabled_at is null and da.deleted_at is null and dp.role <> 'guest'
             and exists (select 1 from channel dch where dch.id = $4::uuid and ((dch.kind = 'standard' and dch.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = dch.id and cm_vis.account_id = account_grant.granted_by)))
             and (dc.invoke_scope = 'community'
               or (dc.invoke_scope = 'list' and exists (select 1 from agent_invoker di where di.agent_id = dc.account_id and di.account_id = dp.id))

pr_watch_member:
select 1 from channel_member cm join message m on m.channel_id = cm.channel_id
      where cm.channel_id = $1::uuid and cm.account_id = $2::uuid and m.id = $3::uuid and m.thread_root_id is null
pr_watch_delegation:
select 1 from team_delegation d
        where d.id = $1::uuid and d.thread_root_id = $2::uuid
          and (d.lead_account_id = $3::uuid or exists (select 1 from team_delegation_item di where di.delegation_id = d.id and di.delegate_account_id = $3::uuid))
pr_watch_count:
select count(distinct w.id)::int as n,
              bool_or(w.repo = $2::text and w.number = $3::int and w.head = $4::text and w.until = $5::text) as already
         from pr_watch_subscriber s join pr_watch w on w.id = s.watch_id
        where s.account_id = $1::uuid and w.state = 'open' and w.expires_at > now()
pr_watch_insert:
insert into pr_watch (repo, number, head, until, expires_at)
       values ($1::text, $2::int, $3::text, $4::text, now() + make_interval(secs => $5::int))
       on conflict (repo, number, head, until) where state = 'open' do update set expires_at = greatest(pr_watch.expires_at, excluded.expires_at)
       returning id, expires_at, (xmax = 0) as created
skill_propose_upsert:
insert into workspace_skill (slug, body, proposed_by, flagged_at, flag_reason)
     values ($1::text, $2::text, $3::uuid, case when $4::text is null then null else now() end, $4::text)
     on conflict (slug) do update set body = excluded.body, proposed_by = excluded.proposed_by,
       proposed_at = now(), approved_by = null, approved_at = null, disabled_at = null,
       flagged_at = excluded.flagged_at, flag_reason = excluded.flag_reason
automation_propose_insert:

pr_watch_subscribe:

grant_mandate_turn_lease:

      where agent_id = $1::uuid and cause_message_id = $2::uuid and operator_id = $3::uuid and channel_id = $4::uuid

grant_mandate_agent_channel:
select 1 from mandate m join agent_config c on c.account_id = $2::uuid

grant_valid_mandate_owner:

      where d.id = $1::uuid and d.ended_at is null

grant_mandate_lines_stored:
select id, mandate_id as "mandateId", cap, scope, limits, agent_ids as "agentIds", granted_by as "grantedBy", via,
  request_id as "requestId", used_count as "usedCount", created_at as "createdAt", revoked_at as "revokedAt" from mandate_line where mandate_id = $1::uuid and revoked_at is null order by created_at, id
mandate_line_from_request_owner: select owner_account_id as owner from mandate where id = $1::uuid
mandate_line_add_mandate:
select owner_account_id as owner, coalesce(delegator_account_id, owner_account_id) as delegator, ended_at is not null as ended
       from mandate where id = $1::uuid
mandate_line_add_agents: select 1 from agent_config where account_id = any($1::uuid[]) and owner_account_id = $2::uuid
mandate_line_add_insert:
insert into mandate_line (mandate_id, cap, scope, limits, agent_ids, granted_by, via, request_id, created_at)
     values ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::uuid[], $6::uuid, $7, $8::uuid, $9::timestamptz) returning id, mandate_id as "mandateId", cap, scope, limits, agent_ids as "agentIds", granted_by as "grantedBy", via,
  request_id as "requestId", used_count as "usedCount", created_at as "createdAt", revoked_at as "revokedAt"
card_thread_root:
select m.mandate_id as "mandateId",
            (m.author_id = $4::uuid or ($5::boolean and exists (select 1 from agent_config c where c.account_id = m.author_id and c.owner_account_id = $3::uuid))) as "ownAuthor"
       from message m where m.id = $1::uuid and m.channel_id = $2::uuid and m.deleted_at is null
        and not (coalesce(m.meta, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'automation') for update of m
card_thread_delegator: select coalesce(delegator_account_id, owner_account_id) as delegator from mandate where id = $1::uuid
card_thread_touch: update mandate set last_activity_at = greatest(last_activity_at, $2::timestamptz) where id = $1::uuid
card_thread_insert:
insert into mandate (owner_account_id, delegator_account_id, root_message_id, channel_id, thread_root_id, created_at, last_activity_at)
     values ($1::uuid, $5::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $2::uuid, $4::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz)
     on conflict (root_message_id) do update set last_activity_at = greatest(mandate.last_activity_at, excluded.last_activity_at)
     returning id, owner_account_id as owner, coalesce(delegator_account_id, owner_account_id) as delegator, ended_at is not null as ended, (xmax = 0) as inserted
card_thread_root_stamp: update message set mandate_id = $2::uuid where id = $1::uuid and mandate_id is null
new_mandate_request: update permission_request set mandate_id = $2::uuid where id = $1::uuid
new_mandate_card: update message set mandate_id = $2::uuid where id = $1::uuid and mandate_id is null and author_id = $3::uuid
grant_command_grants:
select id, command, single_use as "singleUse", expires_at as "expiresAt" from command_grant
      where agent_id = $1::uuid and channel_id = $2::uuid and thread_root_id = $3::uuid and expires_at > $4::timestamptz
        and (not single_use or used_at is null)
        and exists (
    select 1 from agent_config dc join account da on da.id = dc.account_id join account dp on dp.id = command_grant.granted_by
     where dc.account_id = command_grant.agent_id and dp.kind = 'human' and dp.disabled_at is null and dp.deleted_at is null
       and (dc.owner_account_id = dp.id
         or (dc.user_decide and da.disabled_at is null and da.deleted_at is null and dp.role <> 'guest'
             and exists (select 1 from channel dch where dch.id = command_grant.channel_id and ((dch.kind = 'standard' and dch.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = dch.id and cm_vis.account_id = command_grant.granted_by)))
             and (dc.invoke_scope = 'community'
               or (dc.invoke_scope = 'list' and exists (select 1 from agent_invoker di where di.agent_id = dc.account_id and di.account_id = dp.id))
               or (dc.invoke_scope = 'channel' and exists (select 1 from channel_member dm join channel dmc on dmc.id = dm.channel_id
                     where dm.channel_id = command_grant.channel_id and dm.account_id = dp.id and dmc.kind <> 'dm'))))))
      order by created_at
grant_read_lease:
select l.id, l.agent_id as "agentId", l.operator_id as "operatorId", l.channel_id as "channelId",
            l.thread_root_id as "threadRootId", l.expires_at <= $3::timestamptz as expired, l.ended_at is not null as ended,
            l.cause_message_id as "causeMessageId", l.mandate_id as "mandateId",
            a.kind as "causeKind",
            case when m.meta ? 'ask' and m.meta->'ask'->>'mirrorOf' is null and m.meta->'ask'->>'answeredVia' is null
                 then m.author_id end as "causeAskAuthorId",
            m.meta->'ask'->>'answeredBy' as "askAnsweredBy",
            ans.kind as "askAnswererKind",
            -- 답한 사람이 이 카드를 정할 수 있는 사람인가(소유자 결정 2026-10-29 — 소유자 또는 그 채널에서 이 에이전트를 부를 수 있는 사람).
            exists (
    select 1 from agent_config dc join account da on da.id = dc.account_id join account dp on dp.id = ans.id
     where dc.account_id = l.agent_id and dp.kind = 'human' and dp.disabled_at is null and dp.deleted_at is null
       and (dc.owner_account_id = dp.id
         or (dc.user_decide and da.disabled_at is null and da.deleted_at is null and dp.role <> 'guest'
             and exists (select 1 from channel dch where dch.id = m.channel_id and ((dch.kind = 'standard' and dch.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = dch.id and cm_vis.account_id = ans.id)))
             and (dc.invoke_scope = 'community'
               or (dc.invoke_scope = 'list' and exists (select 1 from agent_invoker di where di.agent_id = dc.account_id and di.account_id = dp.id))
               or (dc.invoke_scope = 'channel' and exists (select 1 from channel_member dm join channel dmc on dmc.id = dm.channel_id
                     where dm.channel_id = m.channel_id and dm.account_id = dp.id and dmc.kind <> 'dm')))))) as "askAnswererOwnsAgent"
       from secret_turn_lease l
       left join message m on m.id = l.cause_message_id
       left join account a on a.id = m.author_id
       left join account ans on ans.id = nullif(m.meta->'ask'->>'answeredBy', '')::uuid
      where l.id = $1::uuid and l.token_hash = $2::text
grant_match_command:
update command_grant c set use_count = c.use_count + 1, used_at = coalesce(c.used_at, $5::timestamptz),
            bound_cwd = case when c.single_use then c.bound_cwd else coalesce(c.bound_cwd, $7::text) end
      where c.id = (
        select id from command_grant
         where agent_id = $1::uuid and channel_id = $2::uuid and thread_root_id = $3::uuid and command = $4::text and expires_at > $5::timestamptz
           and (not single_use or used_at is null)
           and exists (
    select 1 from agent_config dc join account da on da.id = dc.account_id join account dp on dp.id = command_grant.granted_by
     where dc.account_id = command_grant.agent_id and dp.kind = 'human' and dp.disabled_at is null and dp.deleted_at is null
       and (dc.owner_account_id = dp.id
         or (dc.user_decide and da.disabled_at is null and da.deleted_at is null and dp.role <> 'guest'
             and exists (select 1 from channel dch where dch.id = command_grant.channel_id and ((dch.kind = 'standard' and dch.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = dch.id and cm_vis.account_id = command_grant.granted_by)))
             and (dc.invoke_scope = 'community'
               or (dc.invoke_scope = 'list' and exists (select 1 from agent_invoker di where di.agent_id = dc.account_id and di.account_id = dp.id))
               or (dc.invoke_scope = 'channel' and exists (select 1 from channel_member dm join channel dmc on dmc.id = dm.channel_id
                     where dm.channel_id = command_grant.channel_id and dm.account_id = dp.id and dmc.kind <> 'dm'))))))
           and file_digests = $6::jsonb
           and (single_use or ($7::text is not null and (bound_cwd is null or bound_cwd = $7::text)))
         order by single_use asc, created_at
         limit 1
         for update skip locked)

        and (c.single_use or ($7::text is not null and (c.bound_cwd is null or c.bound_cwd = $7::text)))
      returning c.id, c.single_use as "singleUse"
turn_lease_cause:
select m.channel_id as "channelId", coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id) as "threadRootId",
              -- 위임 키(133, W1): cause 글의 위임, 없으면 그 글이 연 깨움 행의 위임. 이 에이전트의 지금 소유자가 위임 소유자일 때만.
              (select d.id from mandate d join agent_config c on c.account_id = i.account_id
                where c.owner_account_id = d.owner_account_id
                  -- 위임 후속 보고로 깬 턴은 그 글의 위임을 잇지 않는다.
                  and not exists (select 1 from inbox fu where fu.account_id = i.account_id and fu.message_id = m.id and fu.reason = 'delegation_followup')
                  and d.id = coalesce(m.mandate_id,
                    (select w.mandate_id from agent_wake w where w.message_id = m.id and w.account_id = i.account_id
                      order by w.created_at desc limit 1))) as "mandateId",
              (case
  when exists (select 1 from inbox iw where iw.account_id = i.account_id and iw.message_id = m.id and iw.reason in ('wake', 'delegation_followup')) then null
  when m.kind = 'system' and m.meta ? 'planAuto' then (
    select pa.id from account pa
     where pa.id = m.principal_account_id and pa.kind = 'human' and pa.deleted_at is null and pa.disabled_at is null)
  when m.meta ? 'ask' and m.author_id = i.account_id then (
    select ans.id from account ans
     where ans.id = nullif(m.meta->'ask'->>'answeredBy', '')::uuid
       and ans.kind = 'human' and ans.deleted_at is null and ans.disabled_at is null
       and m.meta->'ask'->>'mirrorOf' is null and m.meta->'ask'->>'answeredVia' is null
       and m.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' is null)
  when a.kind = 'human' and m.kind = 'user' and not (m.meta ? 'automation')
       and a.deleted_at is null and a.disabled_at is null then a.id
  when a.kind = 'agent' then m.principal_account_id
  else null end) as "principalId",
              i.created_at as "inboxAt"
         from inbox i join message m on m.id = i.message_id
         join account a on a.id = m.author_id
        where i.account_id = $1::uuid and i.message_id = $2::uuid and i.read_at is null and i.created_at > $3::timestamptz and m.deleted_at is null
        order by i.created_at
        limit 1

       values ($1, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::uuid, $5::uuid, $6::uuid, $7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz, $9::uuid, $10::uuid, $7::timestamptz, $11::uuid) returning id

            last_renewed_at = $4::timestamptz
      where id = $1::uuid and token_hash = $2 and agent_id = $3::uuid and operator_id = $7::uuid and ended_at is null and expires_at > $4::timestamptz

thread_status_facts:
with t as (
  select m.id, m.seq, m.kind, m.author_id, m.meta, a.kind as author_kind
  from message m join account a on a.id = m.author_id
  where (m.id = $1::uuid or m.thread_root_id = $1::uuid) and m.deleted_at is null
)
select
  -- 묶음에 담긴 원본은 원 스레드의 🙋 가 되지 않고, 열린 줄을 가진 묶음 카드가 그 묶음 스레드의 🙋 가 된다
  -- (선택 카드 P1 3c — Inbox 집계 THREAD_STATE_FACTS 와 같은 조각, askBundleSql.ts).
  (select json_build_object('askerId', t.author_id, 'prompt', t.meta->'ask'->>'prompt')
     from t
     where (t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
       and t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' is null and t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' is null
       and (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'human'
         or (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
           and exists (select 1 from account x where x.id = (CASE WHEN (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId')::uuid END) and x.kind = 'human')))
       and not (CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask' THEN (
        NOT (t.meta ? 'permissionRequest' OR t.meta ? 'mergeDenial')
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message bnd
            JOIN channel bc ON bc.id = bnd.channel_id
           WHERE bnd.meta->>'kind' = 'askBundle' AND bnd.deleted_at IS NULL
             AND bc.kind = 'standard' AND bc.visibility = 'public' AND bc.archived_at IS NULL
             AND bnd.meta->'askBundle'->'items' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('rootId', t.id::text)))) ELSE false END))
       or (CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'askBundle' THEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM message br
         WHERE br.id = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE
            WHEN bi->>'rootId' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
            THEN (bi->>'rootId')::uuid END
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.meta->'askBundle'->'items') bi))
           AND br.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND br.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
           AND br.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL) ELSE false END)
     order by t.seq limit 1) as human_ask,
  (select json_build_object('accountId', t.author_id, 'what', coalesce(t.meta->'failure'->>'what', t.meta->'failure'->>'reason'),
                            'gate', coalesce(t.meta->'failure'->>'code' = 'account_gate', false))
     from t
     where t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure'
       and not exists (
         select 1 from t r where r.seq > t.seq
           and (r.kind in ('progress', 'wake') or r.meta->>'kind' = 'report' or r.author_id = t.author_id))
     order by t.seq desc limit 1) as failure,
  (select json_build_object('authorId', t.author_id, 'targets',
            coalesce(t.meta->'mentionDenied', '[]'::jsonb) || coalesce(t.meta->'mentionChainCapped', '[]'::jsonb))
     from t
     where (jsonb_array_length(coalesce(t.meta->'mentionDenied', '[]'::jsonb)) > 0
         or jsonb_array_length(coalesce(t.meta->'mentionChainCapped', '[]'::jsonb)) > 0)
       and t.seq = (select max(seq) from t)
     limit 1) as denied_mention,
  coalesce(
    (select json_build_object('waiterId', t.author_id, 'blockedById', t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId')
       from t
       where t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
         and t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' is null and t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' is null
         and t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
         and exists (select 1 from account x where x.id = (CASE WHEN (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId')::uuid END) and x.kind = 'agent')
       order by t.seq limit 1),
    (select json_build_object('waiterId', t.author_id, 'blockedById', t.meta->'delegation'->'open'->>0)
       from t
       where t.meta->>'kind' = 'delegation'
         and jsonb_array_length(coalesce(t.meta->'delegation'->'open', '[]'::jsonb)) > 0
       order by t.seq limit 1)
  ) as agent_wait,
  (select json_build_object('accountId', w.account_id, 'wakeAt', w.wake_at)
     from agent_wake w join t on t.id = w.message_id
     where w.fired_at is null and w.canceled_at is null
     order by w.wake_at limit 1) as open_wake,
  -- 이 스레드를 **보고처로 둔** 열린 깨움(2026-10-06). 앵커는 다른 스레드다. 열린 행에서 출발한다(agent_wake_due).
  (select json_build_object('accountId', w.account_id, 'wakeAt', w.wake_at)
     from agent_wake w join message wm on wm.id = w.message_id
     where w.fired_at is null and w.canceled_at is null
       and wm.meta->'wake'->'reportTo'->>'threadRootId' = $1::text
     order by w.wake_at limit 1) as open_report_wake,
  -- 배달된 멘션 중 그 에이전트가 **그 뒤로 아무 말도 안 한** 것. 읽음(read_at)은 보지 않는다 —
  -- 러너가 턴을 시작하며 읽음으로 만든 뒤 첫 진행을 올리기 전까지 ✅ 로 깜빡이지 않게.
  (select json_build_object('agentId', i.account_id)
     from inbox i join t on t.id = i.message_id join account x on x.id = i.account_id
     where x.kind = 'agent' and i.reason <> 'thread_reply'
       and not exists (select 1 from t r where r.seq > t.seq and r.author_id = i.account_id)
     order by t.seq desc limit 1) as pending_mention,
  (select json_build_object('kind', t.kind, 'authorId', t.author_id, 'authorIsAgent', t.author_kind = 'agent')
     from t order by t.seq desc limit 1) as last,
  (exists (select 1 from t where t.author_kind = 'agent')
    or exists (select 1 from inbox i join t on t.id = i.message_id join account x on x.id = i.account_id
               where x.kind = 'agent' and i.reason <> 'thread_reply')) as agent_involved,
  (select channel_id from message where id = $1::uuid and thread_root_id is null) as channel_id
thread_status_sync_reaction:
with want as (select $2::uuid as account_id, $3::text as emoji where $2::uuid is not null and $3::text is not null),
     del as (
       delete from message_reaction r
        where r.message_id = $1::uuid and r.source = 'status'
          and not exists (select 1 from want w where w.account_id = r.account_id and w.emoji = r.emoji)
       returning r.account_id, r.emoji),
     ins as (
       insert into message_reaction (message_id, account_id, emoji, source)
       select $1::uuid, w.account_id, w.emoji, 'status' from want w
        where exists (select 1 from message m where m.id = $1::uuid and m.deleted_at is null)
       on conflict do nothing
       returning account_id, emoji)
     select 'removed' as op, account_id::text as account_id, emoji from del
     union all select 'added' as op, account_id::text as account_id, emoji from ins
thread_status_upsert:
insert into thread_status (root_id, status, emoji, account_id, reason)
       values ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4::uuid, $5)
     on conflict (root_id) do update
       set status = excluded.status, emoji = excluded.emoji, account_id = excluded.account_id,
           reason = excluded.reason, updated_at = now()
       where (thread_status.status, thread_status.account_id, thread_status.reason)
         is distinct from (excluded.status, excluded.account_id, excluded.reason)
     returning to_char(date_trunc('milliseconds', updated_at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as updated_at_iso,

message_by_id:
select id, seq::int as seq, channel_id as "channelId", thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
  author_id as "authorId", body, kind, meta, created_at as "createdAt",
  edited_at as "editedAt", coalesce((
  select json_agg(json_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'accountIds', r."accountIds") order by r."firstAt")
  from (
    select emoji, array_agg(account_id::text order by created_at) as "accountIds",
           min(created_at) as "firstAt"
    from message_reaction where message_id = message.id group by emoji
  ) r
), '[]'::json) as reactions, coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(
      'artifactId', av.artifact_id, 'version', av.version, 'title', coalesce(av.title, ar.title), 'latestTitle', ar.title, 'summary', av.summary,
      'coverAttachmentId', av.cover_attachment_id,
      'latestVersion', (select max(av2.version) from artifact_version av2 where av2.artifact_id = av.artifact_id)))
    from artifact_version av join artifact ar on ar.id = av.artifact_id where av.attachment_id = a.id
  ), '{}'::jsonb)) order by a.attached_at, a.created_at)
  from attachment a where a.message_id = message.id

invoke_team_invoker: select 1 from agent_team_invoker where team_id = $1::uuid and account_id = $2::uuid
invoke_channel_scope:
select 1 from channel_member m join channel ch on ch.id = m.channel_id
          where m.channel_id = $1::uuid and m.account_id = $2::uuid and ch.kind <> 'dm'
invoke_has_reply_grant:
select 1 from invoke_reply_grant
      where grantee_id = $1::uuid and granter_id = $2::uuid and thread_root_id = $3::uuid
        and closed_at is null and expires_at > now()
read_list_row:
select m.id, m.seq::int as seq, m.channel_id as "channelId", m.thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
  m.author_id as "authorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then m.body else '' end as body,
  m.kind, case when m.deleted_at is null then m.meta else '{}'::jsonb end as meta,
  m.created_at as "createdAt",
  m.edited_at as "editedAt",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg(json_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'accountIds', r."accountIds") order by r."firstAt")
  from (
    select emoji, array_agg(account_id::text order by created_at) as "accountIds",
           min(created_at) as "firstAt"
    from message_reaction where message_id = m.id group by emoji
  ) r
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as reactions,
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(
      'artifactId', av.artifact_id, 'version', av.version, 'title', coalesce(av.title, ar.title), 'latestTitle', ar.title, 'summary', av.summary,
      'coverAttachmentId', av.cover_attachment_id,
      'latestVersion', (select max(av2.version) from artifact_version av2 where av2.artifact_id = av.artifact_id)))
    from artifact_version av join artifact ar on ar.id = av.artifact_id where av.attachment_id = a.id
  ), '{}'::jsonb)) order by a.attached_at, a.created_at)
  from attachment a where a.message_id = m.id
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as attachments,
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.reply_count end as "replyCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.activity_count end as "activityCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.last_reply_at end as "lastReplyAt",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.participant_ids end as "participantIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.open_ask_human_count end as "openAskHumanCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.open_ask_account_ids end as "openAskAccountIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.open_gate_account_ids end as "openGateAccountIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.failure_count end as "failureCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.unresolved_failure_count end as "unresolvedFailureCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.open_ask_links end as "openAskLinks",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_last.last_kind end as "lastKind",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_last.last_author_id end as "lastAuthorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (select json_build_object('status', ts.status, 'emoji', ts.emoji, 'accountId', ts.account_id,
    'reason', ts.reason, 'updatedAt', ts.updated_at) from thread_status ts where ts.root_id = m.id) end as "statusReaction",
  m.also_in_channel as "alsoInChannel", m.deleted_at as "deletedAt" from message m LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kind NOT IN ('progress', 'wake'))::int as reply_count,
    COUNT(*)::int as activity_count,
    MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE kind NOT IN ('progress', 'wake'))::text as last_reply_at,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(author_id ORDER BY last_at DESC)
      FROM (
        SELECT author_id, MAX(created_at) as last_at
        FROM message
        WHERE thread_root_id = m.id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND author_id IS NOT NULL
          -- 시스템 줄의 author 는 참여자가 아니다(시스템 줄 C안 c3) — 승인 글을 쓴 사람·알림 대상 에이전트일 뿐이다.
          AND kind <> 'system'
          AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
        GROUP BY author_id
      ) recent
    ), '{}'::uuid[]) as participant_ids
  FROM message WHERE thread_root_id = m.id AND deleted_at IS NULL
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_stats ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    -- 특정 계정에게 간 미답 물음의 수신자들. 화면이 "이것이 내 차례인가"를 여기서 가른다.
    COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId') FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' IS NOT NULL
    ), '{}'::text[]) as open_ask_account_ids,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure')::int as failure_count,
    -- 마디들: 누가 → 누구를 기다리는가(#488 A3-b). 위의 두 집계로는 부족하다 —
    -- open_ask_account_ids 는 '답해야 하는 쪽'만 모은 집합이라 누가 물었는지가
    -- 지워지고, 사슬을 이으려면 짝이 필요하다.
    --
    -- ARRAY_AGG 가 아니라 JSONB_AGG 인 이유가 그것이다: 두 값을 한 행으로 묶어
    -- 내보내야 짝이 유지된다. 배열 둘로 내면 순서가 같다는 보장이 없다.
    --
    -- 'human' 은 blockedBy = null 로 낸다 — 계정 id 로 대신 채우면 그 사람만
    -- 기다리는 것처럼 보인다(open_ask_human_count 를 따로 둔 것과 같은 이유).
    COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(
      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'waiter', t.author_id::text,
        'blockedBy', CASE WHEN t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
          THEN t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' END,
        'askedAt', t.created_at
      ) ORDER BY t.seq
    ) FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.author_id IS NOT NULL
        -- 사람 아무나(human)와 특정 계정(account) 둘 다 마디가 된다. 그 밖의
        -- to.kind 는 화면이 이을 수 없으므로 넣지 않는다.
        AND (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'human'
          OR (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
            AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' IS NOT NULL))
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
    -- 위임 마디(3-3). 팀장이 기다리는 팀원 하나마다 한 마디다.
    --
    -- 물음과 같은 목록에 넣는 이유: 사슬을 잇는 walk() 는 마디의 출처를 묻지 않는다 —
    -- 누가 누구를 기다리는가 하나만 본다. 목록을 갈라 두 벌로 내면 화면이 그 둘을 합치는
    -- 코드를 또 쓰게 되고, 그 합치기가 스레드 안(메시지에서 만든 사슬)과 갈라진다.
    --
    -- 위임 하나가 여러 마디가 되므로(팀원 N 명) jsonb_array_elements_text 로 펼친다.
    -- ask 는 상대가 하나라 그 펼침이 없었고, 그래서 별도 집계가 필요하다.
    || COALESCE((
      SELECT JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('waiter', d.author_id::text, 'blockedBy', o.id, 'askedAt', d.created_at)
        ORDER BY d.seq
      )
      FROM message d, LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(d.meta->'delegation'->'open') AS o(id)
      WHERE (d.id = m.id OR d.thread_root_id = m.id) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND d.meta->>'kind' = 'delegation' AND d.author_id IS NOT NULL
        AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
    ), '[]'::jsonb) as open_ask_links
  FROM message t
  WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_state ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  -- **묶음·실패 판정은 후보 행에서만 센다**(2026-10-24, JIT 문턱). 아래 셋은 행마다 하위 질의(묶음 색인·뒤에 말이 있는가)를
  -- 부른다. 위 집계의 FILTER 안에 두면 CASE 덕에 실제로는 후보 행에서만 돌지만, 플래너는 그 비용을 스레드의 **모든 행**에
  -- 매긴다 — 머리 한 행이 수천~수만이 되어 목록 쿼리 하나가 jit_above_cost 를 몇십 배 넘었고, 실행 6ms 쿼리가 JIT 컴파일로
  -- 5초를 썼다(운영 측정, 스레드 답글 339). 종류 조건을 스캔의 WHERE 로 내리면 그 하위 질의는 걸러진 행 수만큼만 매겨진다.
  -- 뜻은 같다: 셋 다 kind 가 ask·askBundle·failure 가 아닌 행에서는 원래 FILTER 가 거짓이었다.
  SELECT
    -- 사람 아무나에게 간 미답 물음의 수. 누구인지 물을 수 없으므로 수로만 낸다.
    -- **closedAt 도 닫는다**(2026-09-09). 답하지 않기로 한 물음은 열려 있지 않다 — 이
    -- 조건이 없으면 사람이 그만두기로 한 뒤에도 대기 줄과 '내 차례' 배지가 남는다. 같은
    -- 판정이 shared::isAskOpen 에 있다(SQL 은 그 함수를 부를 수 없어 다시 적는다) —
    -- **필드가 늘면 두 자리를 함께 고친다.**
    -- **묶음 카드는 묶음 하나에 한 번 센다**(선택 카드 P1 3c, 2026-10-11). 묶음에 담긴 원본은 원 스레드에서 세지
    -- 않고, 열린 줄을 가진 묶음 카드가 그 묶음 스레드에서 하나로 선다 — 같은 결정이 🙋·Inbox 에 두 번 서지 않게.
    -- 판정은 askBundleSql.ts 하나(threadStatus 의 FACTS_SQL 과 같은 조각).
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'human'
        AND NOT (CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask' THEN (
        NOT (t.meta ? 'permissionRequest' OR t.meta ? 'mergeDenial')
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message bnd
            JOIN channel bc ON bc.id = bnd.channel_id
           WHERE bnd.meta->>'kind' = 'askBundle' AND bnd.deleted_at IS NULL
             AND bc.kind = 'standard' AND bc.visibility = 'public' AND bc.archived_at IS NULL
             AND bnd.meta->'askBundle'->'items' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('rootId', t.id::text)))) ELSE false END)
    ) + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'askBundle' THEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM message br
         WHERE br.id = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE
            WHEN bi->>'rootId' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
            THEN (bi->>'rootId')::uuid END
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.meta->'askBundle'->'items') bi))
           AND br.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND br.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
           AND br.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL) ELSE false END)))::int as open_ask_human_count,
    -- **안 풀린** 실패만 따로 센다. 위의 누적 개수로 '막힘'을 칠하면 한 번 실패한 스레드는
    -- 그 뒤에 에이전트가 다시 붙어 진행 설명을 올리고 있어도 영원히 붉게 남는다 — 사람이
    -- 보는 화면에서 "작업 중"이 계속 "막힘"으로 뒤집히던 것이 이것이다.
    --
    -- 해소의 정의: **그 실패보다 뒤에 에이전트의 말이 있으면 풀린 것이다.** 에이전트의
    -- 말이란 (a) 진행 설명·대기 줄(kind), (b) 완료 보고(meta.kind), (c) **그 실패를 낸
    -- 계정 자신의 아무 말**이다. (c) 가 필요한 이유는 마지막 답을 평범한 글로 내는 러너가
    -- 있어서고, 그때 그 계정이 에이전트라는 것은 실패를 낸 자가 그 계정이라는 사실이
    -- 이미 말해 준다 — account 를 조인하지 않고도 안다.
    --
    -- 사람이 되묻는 말은 풀지 않는다. 그때는 정말로 막혀 있는 것이고, 그것을 '끝남'으로
    -- 칠하는 것이 이 필드가 막으려는 반대쪽 거짓말이다.
    --
    -- **CASE 로 감싼다**(2026-10-13 쿼리 개선 Q1). 집계의 FILTER 안 AND 는 적힌 순서대로 끊기지 않아, 이 하위 질의가
    -- 실패가 아닌 행에서도 돌았다 — 보드 머리 한 번에 스레드의 모든 행만큼(로컬 17,543번·11.5만 블록). CASE 는 평가 순서를
    -- 약속한다. 아래 open_gate_account_ids 도 같다.
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure' THEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message r
          WHERE (r.id = m.id OR r.thread_root_id = m.id)
            AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND r.seq > t.seq
            AND (r.kind IN ('progress', 'wake')
              OR r.meta->>'kind' = 'report'
              OR r.author_id = t.author_id)
        ) ELSE false END
    )::int as unresolved_failure_count,
    -- 안 풀린 account_gate 실패의 차례 주인들(2026-10-02). 해소 규칙은 바로 위와 **같다** —
    -- 갈라지면 🙋 가 풀린 뒤에도 Inbox 의 내 차례에 남는다. 차례 주인을 못 정한 실패
    -- (awaitingAccountId 없음)는 넣지 않는다: 아무 계정 id 로 채우면 그 사람만 강조를 받는다.
    COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.meta->'failure'->>'awaitingAccountId') FILTER (
      WHERE CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure'
        AND t.meta->'failure'->>'code' = 'account_gate'
        AND t.meta->'failure'->>'awaitingAccountId' IS NOT NULL
        THEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message r
          WHERE (r.id = m.id OR r.thread_root_id = m.id)
            AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND r.seq > t.seq
            AND (r.kind IN ('progress', 'wake')
              OR r.meta->>'kind' = 'report'
              OR r.author_id = t.author_id)
        ) ELSE false END
    ), '{}'::text[]) as open_gate_account_ids
  FROM message t
  WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND t.meta->>'kind' IN ('ask', 'askBundle', 'failure')
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_open ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  -- 마지막 말 하나. 그것이 진행이고 저자가 살아 있는 에이전트일 때만 '도는 중'이므로,
  -- 화면은 이 둘(kind·저자)에 자기가 아는 생존을 곱해 판정한다.
  --
  -- 「가장 최근의 살아 있는 답글」과 「루트 자신」 둘 중 seq 가 큰 것이다(2026-10-13 쿼리 개선 Q4). 예전 꼴
  -- WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1 은 OR 때문에 색인 순서를 못 써서
  -- 스레드 전체를 모아 정렬했다(답글 2,600개 스레드면 2,600행 정렬). 답글 쪽은 (thread_root_id, seq) 색인을
  -- 거꾸로 한 줄만 읽고, 루트는 이미 손에 있는 m 이다. 둘을 seq 로 견주므로 뜻은 같다.
  SELECT x.kind as last_kind, x.author_id as last_author_id
  FROM (
    (SELECT t.kind, t.author_id::text as author_id, t.seq
       FROM message t
      WHERE t.thread_root_id = m.id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
        -- 시스템 줄은 누구의 말도 아니다 — 「마지막 말」에서 뺀다(시스템 줄 C안 c3).
        AND t.kind <> 'system'
        -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
        AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
      ORDER BY t.seq DESC LIMIT 1)
    UNION ALL
    (SELECT m.kind, m.author_id::text, m.seq
      WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL)
  ) x
  ORDER BY x.seq DESC LIMIT 1
) thread_last ON true
     where m.channel_id = $1::uuid and m.id = $2::uuid and (m.deleted_at is null or (m.thread_root_id is null and exists (
  select 1 from message r
   where r.thread_root_id = m.id and r.deleted_at is null
     and r.kind not in ('progress', 'wake')
)))
channel_post_gate:
select ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = $2::uuid)) as visible,
            c.archived_at is not null as archived
     from channel c where c.id = $1::uuid
list_channels:
select id, name, topic, kind, repo, archived_at as "archivedAt", visibility, created_at as "createdAt" from channel c
     where c.kind = 'standard' and ((c.kind = 'standard' and $2::bool)
     or ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = $1::uuid)))
     order by name
all_read_states:
select
       c.id as "channelId",
       (least(
       coalesce(r.last_read_seq, 0),
       coalesce(r.unread_from_seq - 1, coalesce(r.last_read_seq, 0))
     ))::int as "lastReadSeq",
       (select count(*) from message m
         where m.channel_id = c.id
           and m.deleted_at is null
           and m.author_id <> $1::uuid
           and m.seq > (least(
       coalesce(r.last_read_seq, 0),
       coalesce(r.unread_from_seq - 1, coalesce(r.last_read_seq, 0))
     )))::int as unread
     from channel c
     left join channel_read r on r.account_id = $1::uuid and r.channel_id = c.id
     where ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = $1::uuid))
     order by c.id
read_state:
select
       (least(
       coalesce(r.last_read_seq, 0),
       coalesce(r.unread_from_seq - 1, coalesce(r.last_read_seq, 0))
     ))::int as "lastReadSeq",
       (select count(*) from message m
         where m.channel_id = $2::uuid
           and m.deleted_at is null            -- 지운 메시지는 미읽음이 아니다
           and m.author_id <> $1::uuid         -- 내가 쓴 것도 아니다(발화마다 배지가 뜨면 안 된다)
           and m.seq > (least(
       coalesce(r.last_read_seq, 0),
       coalesce(r.unread_from_seq - 1, coalesce(r.last_read_seq, 0))
     )))::int as unread
     from (select 1) one
     left join channel_read r on r.account_id = $1::uuid and r.channel_id = $2::uuid
list_channel_members:
select m.account_id as "accountId", a.handle
     from channel_member m join account a on a.id = m.account_id
     where m.channel_id = $1::uuid order by a.handle
list_channel_prefs:
select account_id as "accountId", channel_id as "channelId", muted_at as "mutedAt", starred_at as "starredAt",
            notify_level as "notifyLevel", section, section_id as "sectionId", sort_order as "sortOrder",
            hidden_at as "hiddenAt"
     from channel_pref where account_id = $1::uuid
list_channel_sections: select id, name, position, collapsed, created_at as "createdAt" from channel_section where account_id = $1::uuid order by position, name
list_channel_auto_mentions:
select m.channel_id as "channelId", m.agent_account_id as "agentAccountId", a.handle,
  m.mode, m.created_by as "createdBy", m.created_at as "createdAt" from channel_auto_mention m join account a on a.id = m.agent_account_id where m.channel_id = $1::uuid order by a.handle
channel_doc:
select d.channel_id as "channelId", d.body, d.updated_by as "updatedBy",
            d.updated_at as "updatedAt"
     from channel_doc d where d.channel_id = $1::uuid
set_channel_auto_mention:
insert into channel_auto_mention (channel_id, agent_account_id, created_by, mode)
     select $1::uuid, a.id, $3::uuid, $4 from account a left join agent_config c on c.account_id = a.id
      where a.id = $2::uuid and a.kind = 'agent' and a.disabled_at is null
        -- 스펙 2026-09-20 §6: auto-mention 은 "소유자가 아닌 무언가가 부르는 것"이라 community 만.
        and coalesce(c.invoke_scope, 'community') = 'community'
     on conflict (channel_id, agent_account_id) do update set mode = excluded.mode
channel_auto_mention_row:
select m.channel_id as "channelId", m.agent_account_id as "agentAccountId", a.handle,
  m.mode, m.created_by as "createdBy", m.created_at as "createdAt" from channel_auto_mention m join account a on a.id = m.agent_account_id where m.channel_id = $1::uuid and m.agent_account_id = $2::uuid
auto_mention_account:
select a.kind, a.disabled_at is not null as disabled, coalesce(c.invoke_scope, 'community') as invoke_scope
         from account a left join agent_config c on c.account_id = a.id where a.id = $1::uuid
unset_channel_auto_mention: delete from channel_auto_mention where channel_id = $1::uuid and agent_account_id = $2::uuid
auto_mention_handle:
select a.handle from channel_auto_mention m join account a on a.id = m.agent_account_id
        where m.channel_id = $1::uuid and m.agent_account_id = $2::uuid
channel_kind_visibility: select kind, visibility from channel where id = $1::uuid
add_channel_member: insert into channel_member (channel_id, account_id) values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid) on conflict do nothing
update_channel_doc:
insert into channel_doc (channel_id, body, updated_by, updated_at)
     values ($1::uuid, $2, $3::uuid, now())
     on conflict (channel_id) do update
       set body = excluded.body, updated_by = excluded.updated_by, updated_at = now()
       where channel_doc.updated_at = $4::timestamptz
     returning channel_id
create_channel:
insert into channel (name, topic, kind, repo, visibility, created_by)
       values ($1, $2, 'standard', $3, $4, $5::uuid) returning id, name, topic, kind, repo, archived_at as "archivedAt", visibility, created_at as "createdAt"
update_channel:
update channel set
       name  = case when $10::bool then $11::text else name  end,
       topic = case when $2::bool then $3::text else topic end,
       repo  = case when $4::bool then $5::text else repo  end,
       archived_at = case when $6::bool is true then now() when $6::bool is false then null else archived_at end,
       archived_by = case when $6::bool is true then $7::uuid when $6::bool is false then null else archived_by end,
       visibility = case when $8::bool then $9::text else visibility end
     where id = $1::uuid and kind = 'standard'
     returning id, name, topic, kind, repo, archived_at as "archivedAt", visibility, created_at as "createdAt"
channel_name_visibility: select name, visibility from channel where id = $1::uuid
find_dm:
select c.id from channel c
     join channel_member m on m.channel_id = c.id
     where c.kind = 'dm'
     group by c.id
     having array_agg(m.account_id order by m.account_id) = $1::uuid[]
create_dm: insert into channel (kind, topic) values ('dm', '') returning id, name, topic, kind, repo, archived_at as "archivedAt", visibility, created_at as "createdAt"
channel_row: select id, name, topic, kind, repo, archived_at as "archivedAt", visibility, created_at as "createdAt" from channel where id = $1::uuid
any_block_between:
select 1 from account_block
      where (blocker_id = $1::uuid and blocked_id = any($2::uuid[]))
         or (blocked_id = $1::uuid and blocker_id = any($2::uuid[]))
      limit 1
channel_membership_gate: select c.kind, c.archived_at is not null as archived from channel c where c.id = $1::uuid
remove_channel_member: delete from channel_member where channel_id = $1::uuid and account_id = $2::uuid
member_system_bodies: {"added":"{account}님이 채널에 추가되었습니다.","left":"{account}님이 채널에서 나갔습니다.","removed":"{account}님이 채널에서 제거되었습니다."}
list_scheduled:
select id, channel_id as "channelId", author_id as "authorId",
  thread_root_id as "threadRootId", body, send_at as "sendAt",
  created_at as "createdAt", sent_message_id as "sentMessageId",
  failed_reason as "failedReason", canceled_at as "canceledAt" from scheduled_message
     where channel_id = $1::uuid and author_id = $2::uuid
     order by send_at
select_pins:
select m.*, p.pinned_by as "pinnedBy", p.pinned_at as "pinnedAt"
     from message_pin p
     join lateral (
       select id, seq::int as seq, channel_id as "channelId", thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
  author_id as "authorId", body, kind, meta, created_at as "createdAt",
  edited_at as "editedAt", coalesce((
  select json_agg(json_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'accountIds', r."accountIds") order by r."firstAt")
  from (
    select emoji, array_agg(account_id::text order by created_at) as "accountIds",
           min(created_at) as "firstAt"
    from message_reaction where message_id = message.id group by emoji
  ) r
), '[]'::json) as reactions, coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(
      'artifactId', av.artifact_id, 'version', av.version, 'title', coalesce(av.title, ar.title), 'latestTitle', ar.title, 'summary', av.summary,
      'coverAttachmentId', av.cover_attachment_id,
      'latestVersion', (select max(av2.version) from artifact_version av2 where av2.artifact_id = av.artifact_id)))
    from artifact_version av join artifact ar on ar.id = av.artifact_id where av.attachment_id = a.id
  ), '{}'::jsonb)) order by a.attached_at, a.created_at)
  from attachment a where a.message_id = message.id
), '[]'::json) as attachments,
  null::int as "replyCount", null::int as "activityCount",
  null::text as "lastReplyAt", null::text[] as "participantIds",
  null::int as "openAskHumanCount", null::text[] as "openAskAccountIds", null::jsonb as "openAskLinks",
  null::text[] as "openGateAccountIds",
  null::int as "failureCount", null::int as "unresolvedFailureCount",
  null::text as "lastKind", null::text as "lastAuthorId",
  (select json_build_object('status', ts.status, 'emoji', ts.emoji, 'accountId', ts.account_id,
    'reason', ts.reason, 'updatedAt', ts.updated_at) from thread_status ts where ts.root_id = message.id) as "statusReaction",
  also_in_channel as "alsoInChannel", deleted_at as "deletedAt" from message
       where message.id = p.message_id and message.deleted_at is null
     ) m on true
     where p.channel_id = $1::uuid and ($2::uuid is null or p.message_id = $2::uuid)
     order by p.pinned_at desc
pin_insert:
insert into message_pin (message_id, channel_id, pinned_by)
     select message.id, message.channel_id, $3::uuid
     from message
     where message.id = $1::uuid and message.channel_id = $2::uuid and message.deleted_at is null
     on conflict (message_id) do nothing
unpin_find: select pinned_by::text as pinned_by from message_pin where message_id = $1::uuid and channel_id = $2::uuid
schedule_insert:
insert into scheduled_message (channel_id, author_id, thread_root_id, body, send_at)
     values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4, $5::timestamptz) returning id, channel_id as "channelId", author_id as "authorId",
  thread_root_id as "threadRootId", body, send_at as "sendAt",
  created_at as "createdAt", sent_message_id as "sentMessageId",
  failed_reason as "failedReason", canceled_at as "canceledAt"
cancel_scheduled:
update scheduled_message set canceled_at = now()
     where id = $1::uuid and author_id = $2::uuid and canceled_at is null
       and sent_message_id is null and failed_reason is null
     returning id
channel_delete_info: select id, name, kind, archived_at from channel where id = $1::uuid
channel_message_count: select count(*)::int as cnt from message where channel_id = $1::uuid
list_messages_threadAround:
select * from (
           (select m.id, m.seq::int as seq, m.channel_id as "channelId", m.thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
  m.author_id as "authorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then m.body else '' end as body,
  m.kind, case when m.deleted_at is null then m.meta else '{}'::jsonb end as meta,
  m.created_at as "createdAt",
  m.edited_at as "editedAt",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg(json_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'accountIds', r."accountIds") order by r."firstAt")
  from (
    select emoji, array_agg(account_id::text order by created_at) as "accountIds",
           min(created_at) as "firstAt"
    from message_reaction where message_id = m.id group by emoji
  ) r
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as reactions,
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(
      'artifactId', av.artifact_id, 'version', av.version, 'title', coalesce(av.title, ar.title), 'latestTitle', ar.title, 'summary', av.summary,
      'coverAttachmentId', av.cover_attachment_id,
      'latestVersion', (select max(av2.version) from artifact_version av2 where av2.artifact_id = av.artifact_id)))
    from artifact_version av join artifact ar on ar.id = av.artifact_id where av.attachment_id = a.id
  ), '{}'::jsonb)) order by a.attached_at, a.created_at)
  from attachment a where a.message_id = m.id
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as attachments,
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.reply_count end as "replyCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.activity_count end as "activityCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.last_reply_at end as "lastReplyAt",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.participant_ids end as "participantIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.open_ask_human_count end as "openAskHumanCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.open_ask_account_ids end as "openAskAccountIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.open_gate_account_ids end as "openGateAccountIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.failure_count end as "failureCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.unresolved_failure_count end as "unresolvedFailureCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.open_ask_links end as "openAskLinks",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_last.last_kind end as "lastKind",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_last.last_author_id end as "lastAuthorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (select json_build_object('status', ts.status, 'emoji', ts.emoji, 'accountId', ts.account_id,
    'reason', ts.reason, 'updatedAt', ts.updated_at) from thread_status ts where ts.root_id = m.id) end as "statusReaction",
  m.also_in_channel as "alsoInChannel", m.deleted_at as "deletedAt" from message m LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kind NOT IN ('progress', 'wake'))::int as reply_count,
    COUNT(*)::int as activity_count,
    MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE kind NOT IN ('progress', 'wake'))::text as last_reply_at,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(author_id ORDER BY last_at DESC)
      FROM (
        SELECT author_id, MAX(created_at) as last_at
        FROM message
        WHERE thread_root_id = m.id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND author_id IS NOT NULL
          -- 시스템 줄의 author 는 참여자가 아니다(시스템 줄 C안 c3) — 승인 글을 쓴 사람·알림 대상 에이전트일 뿐이다.
          AND kind <> 'system'
          AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
        GROUP BY author_id
      ) recent
    ), '{}'::uuid[]) as participant_ids
  FROM message WHERE thread_root_id = m.id AND deleted_at IS NULL
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_stats ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    -- 특정 계정에게 간 미답 물음의 수신자들. 화면이 "이것이 내 차례인가"를 여기서 가른다.
    COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId') FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' IS NOT NULL
    ), '{}'::text[]) as open_ask_account_ids,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure')::int as failure_count,
    -- 마디들: 누가 → 누구를 기다리는가(#488 A3-b). 위의 두 집계로는 부족하다 —
    -- open_ask_account_ids 는 '답해야 하는 쪽'만 모은 집합이라 누가 물었는지가
    -- 지워지고, 사슬을 이으려면 짝이 필요하다.
    --
    -- ARRAY_AGG 가 아니라 JSONB_AGG 인 이유가 그것이다: 두 값을 한 행으로 묶어
    -- 내보내야 짝이 유지된다. 배열 둘로 내면 순서가 같다는 보장이 없다.
    --
    -- 'human' 은 blockedBy = null 로 낸다 — 계정 id 로 대신 채우면 그 사람만
    -- 기다리는 것처럼 보인다(open_ask_human_count 를 따로 둔 것과 같은 이유).
    COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(
      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'waiter', t.author_id::text,
        'blockedBy', CASE WHEN t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
          THEN t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' END,
        'askedAt', t.created_at
      ) ORDER BY t.seq
    ) FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.author_id IS NOT NULL
        -- 사람 아무나(human)와 특정 계정(account) 둘 다 마디가 된다. 그 밖의
        -- to.kind 는 화면이 이을 수 없으므로 넣지 않는다.
        AND (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'human'
          OR (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
            AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' IS NOT NULL))
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
    -- 위임 마디(3-3). 팀장이 기다리는 팀원 하나마다 한 마디다.
    --
    -- 물음과 같은 목록에 넣는 이유: 사슬을 잇는 walk() 는 마디의 출처를 묻지 않는다 —
    -- 누가 누구를 기다리는가 하나만 본다. 목록을 갈라 두 벌로 내면 화면이 그 둘을 합치는
    -- 코드를 또 쓰게 되고, 그 합치기가 스레드 안(메시지에서 만든 사슬)과 갈라진다.
    --
    -- 위임 하나가 여러 마디가 되므로(팀원 N 명) jsonb_array_elements_text 로 펼친다.
    -- ask 는 상대가 하나라 그 펼침이 없었고, 그래서 별도 집계가 필요하다.
    || COALESCE((
      SELECT JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('waiter', d.author_id::text, 'blockedBy', o.id, 'askedAt', d.created_at)
        ORDER BY d.seq
      )
      FROM message d, LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(d.meta->'delegation'->'open') AS o(id)
      WHERE (d.id = m.id OR d.thread_root_id = m.id) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND d.meta->>'kind' = 'delegation' AND d.author_id IS NOT NULL
        AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
    ), '[]'::jsonb) as open_ask_links
  FROM message t
  WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_state ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  -- **묶음·실패 판정은 후보 행에서만 센다**(2026-10-24, JIT 문턱). 아래 셋은 행마다 하위 질의(묶음 색인·뒤에 말이 있는가)를
  -- 부른다. 위 집계의 FILTER 안에 두면 CASE 덕에 실제로는 후보 행에서만 돌지만, 플래너는 그 비용을 스레드의 **모든 행**에
  -- 매긴다 — 머리 한 행이 수천~수만이 되어 목록 쿼리 하나가 jit_above_cost 를 몇십 배 넘었고, 실행 6ms 쿼리가 JIT 컴파일로
  -- 5초를 썼다(운영 측정, 스레드 답글 339). 종류 조건을 스캔의 WHERE 로 내리면 그 하위 질의는 걸러진 행 수만큼만 매겨진다.
  -- 뜻은 같다: 셋 다 kind 가 ask·askBundle·failure 가 아닌 행에서는 원래 FILTER 가 거짓이었다.
  SELECT
    -- 사람 아무나에게 간 미답 물음의 수. 누구인지 물을 수 없으므로 수로만 낸다.
    -- **closedAt 도 닫는다**(2026-09-09). 답하지 않기로 한 물음은 열려 있지 않다 — 이
    -- 조건이 없으면 사람이 그만두기로 한 뒤에도 대기 줄과 '내 차례' 배지가 남는다. 같은
    -- 판정이 shared::isAskOpen 에 있다(SQL 은 그 함수를 부를 수 없어 다시 적는다) —
    -- **필드가 늘면 두 자리를 함께 고친다.**
    -- **묶음 카드는 묶음 하나에 한 번 센다**(선택 카드 P1 3c, 2026-10-11). 묶음에 담긴 원본은 원 스레드에서 세지
    -- 않고, 열린 줄을 가진 묶음 카드가 그 묶음 스레드에서 하나로 선다 — 같은 결정이 🙋·Inbox 에 두 번 서지 않게.
    -- 판정은 askBundleSql.ts 하나(threadStatus 의 FACTS_SQL 과 같은 조각).
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'human'
        AND NOT (CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask' THEN (
        NOT (t.meta ? 'permissionRequest' OR t.meta ? 'mergeDenial')
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message bnd
            JOIN channel bc ON bc.id = bnd.channel_id
           WHERE bnd.meta->>'kind' = 'askBundle' AND bnd.deleted_at IS NULL
             AND bc.kind = 'standard' AND bc.visibility = 'public' AND bc.archived_at IS NULL
             AND bnd.meta->'askBundle'->'items' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('rootId', t.id::text)))) ELSE false END)
    ) + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'askBundle' THEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM message br
         WHERE br.id = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE
            WHEN bi->>'rootId' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
            THEN (bi->>'rootId')::uuid END
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.meta->'askBundle'->'items') bi))
           AND br.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND br.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
           AND br.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL) ELSE false END)))::int as open_ask_human_count,
    -- **안 풀린** 실패만 따로 센다. 위의 누적 개수로 '막힘'을 칠하면 한 번 실패한 스레드는
    -- 그 뒤에 에이전트가 다시 붙어 진행 설명을 올리고 있어도 영원히 붉게 남는다 — 사람이
    -- 보는 화면에서 "작업 중"이 계속 "막힘"으로 뒤집히던 것이 이것이다.
    --
    -- 해소의 정의: **그 실패보다 뒤에 에이전트의 말이 있으면 풀린 것이다.** 에이전트의
    -- 말이란 (a) 진행 설명·대기 줄(kind), (b) 완료 보고(meta.kind), (c) **그 실패를 낸
    -- 계정 자신의 아무 말**이다. (c) 가 필요한 이유는 마지막 답을 평범한 글로 내는 러너가
    -- 있어서고, 그때 그 계정이 에이전트라는 것은 실패를 낸 자가 그 계정이라는 사실이
    -- 이미 말해 준다 — account 를 조인하지 않고도 안다.
    --
    -- 사람이 되묻는 말은 풀지 않는다. 그때는 정말로 막혀 있는 것이고, 그것을 '끝남'으로
    -- 칠하는 것이 이 필드가 막으려는 반대쪽 거짓말이다.
    --
    -- **CASE 로 감싼다**(2026-10-13 쿼리 개선 Q1). 집계의 FILTER 안 AND 는 적힌 순서대로 끊기지 않아, 이 하위 질의가
    -- 실패가 아닌 행에서도 돌았다 — 보드 머리 한 번에 스레드의 모든 행만큼(로컬 17,543번·11.5만 블록). CASE 는 평가 순서를
    -- 약속한다. 아래 open_gate_account_ids 도 같다.
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure' THEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message r
          WHERE (r.id = m.id OR r.thread_root_id = m.id)
            AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND r.seq > t.seq
            AND (r.kind IN ('progress', 'wake')
              OR r.meta->>'kind' = 'report'
              OR r.author_id = t.author_id)
        ) ELSE false END
    )::int as unresolved_failure_count,
    -- 안 풀린 account_gate 실패의 차례 주인들(2026-10-02). 해소 규칙은 바로 위와 **같다** —
    -- 갈라지면 🙋 가 풀린 뒤에도 Inbox 의 내 차례에 남는다. 차례 주인을 못 정한 실패
    -- (awaitingAccountId 없음)는 넣지 않는다: 아무 계정 id 로 채우면 그 사람만 강조를 받는다.
    COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.meta->'failure'->>'awaitingAccountId') FILTER (
      WHERE CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure'
        AND t.meta->'failure'->>'code' = 'account_gate'
        AND t.meta->'failure'->>'awaitingAccountId' IS NOT NULL
        THEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message r
          WHERE (r.id = m.id OR r.thread_root_id = m.id)
            AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND r.seq > t.seq
            AND (r.kind IN ('progress', 'wake')
              OR r.meta->>'kind' = 'report'
              OR r.author_id = t.author_id)
        ) ELSE false END
    ), '{}'::text[]) as open_gate_account_ids
  FROM message t
  WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND t.meta->>'kind' IN ('ask', 'askBundle', 'failure')
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_open ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  -- 마지막 말 하나. 그것이 진행이고 저자가 살아 있는 에이전트일 때만 '도는 중'이므로,
  -- 화면은 이 둘(kind·저자)에 자기가 아는 생존을 곱해 판정한다.
  --
  -- 「가장 최근의 살아 있는 답글」과 「루트 자신」 둘 중 seq 가 큰 것이다(2026-10-13 쿼리 개선 Q4). 예전 꼴
  -- WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1 은 OR 때문에 색인 순서를 못 써서
  -- 스레드 전체를 모아 정렬했다(답글 2,600개 스레드면 2,600행 정렬). 답글 쪽은 (thread_root_id, seq) 색인을
  -- 거꾸로 한 줄만 읽고, 루트는 이미 손에 있는 m 이다. 둘을 seq 로 견주므로 뜻은 같다.
  SELECT x.kind as last_kind, x.author_id as last_author_id
  FROM (
    (SELECT t.kind, t.author_id::text as author_id, t.seq
       FROM message t
      WHERE t.thread_root_id = m.id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
        -- 시스템 줄은 누구의 말도 아니다 — 「마지막 말」에서 뺀다(시스템 줄 C안 c3).
        AND t.kind <> 'system'
        -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
        AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
      ORDER BY t.seq DESC LIMIT 1)
    UNION ALL
    (SELECT m.kind, m.author_id::text, m.seq
      WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL)
  ) x
  ORDER BY x.seq DESC LIMIT 1
) thread_last ON true
            where m.channel_id = $1::uuid and m.id = $2::uuid and (m.deleted_at is null or (m.thread_root_id is null and exists (
  select 1 from message r
   where r.thread_root_id = m.id and r.deleted_at is null
     and r.kind not in ('progress', 'wake')
))))
           -- 루트는 아래 갈래(thread_root_id = $2::uuid)에 절대 걸리지 않으므로 중복이 없다.
           -- union(중복 제거)은 json 컬럼에 등호가 없어 터진다 — union all 이어야 한다.
           union all
           (select * from (
              (select m.id, m.seq::int as seq, m.channel_id as "channelId", m.thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
  m.author_id as "authorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then m.body else '' end as body,

  m.created_at as "createdAt",
  m.edited_at as "editedAt",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg(json_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'accountIds', r."accountIds") order by r."firstAt")

  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(
      'artifactId', av.artifact_id, 'version', av.version, 'title', coalesce(av.title, ar.title), 'latestTitle', ar.title, 'summary', av.summary,
      'coverAttachmentId', av.cover_attachment_id,

    from artifact_version av join artifact ar on ar.id = av.artifact_id where av.attachment_id = a.id
  ), '{}'::jsonb)) order by a.attached_at, a.created_at)
  from attachment a where a.message_id = m.id
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as attachments,
  null::int as "replyCount",
  null::int as "activityCount",
  null::text as "lastReplyAt",
  null::uuid[] as "participantIds",
  null::int as "openAskHumanCount",
  null::text[] as "openAskAccountIds",
  null::text[] as "openGateAccountIds",
  null::int as "failureCount",
  null::int as "unresolvedFailureCount",
  null::jsonb as "openAskLinks",
  null::text as "lastKind",
  null::text as "lastAuthorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (select json_build_object('status', ts.status, 'emoji', ts.emoji, 'accountId', ts.account_id,
    'reason', ts.reason, 'updatedAt', ts.updated_at) from thread_status ts where ts.root_id = m.id) end as "statusReaction",
  m.also_in_channel as "alsoInChannel", m.deleted_at as "deletedAt" from message m

  select 1 from message r
   where r.thread_root_id = m.id and r.deleted_at is null
     and r.kind not in ('progress', 'wake')
)))
               order by m.seq desc limit $4)
              union all
              (select m.id, m.seq::int as seq, m.channel_id as "channelId", m.thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
  m.author_id as "authorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then m.body else '' end as body,
  m.kind, case when m.deleted_at is null then m.meta else '{}'::jsonb end as meta,

  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(
      'artifactId', av.artifact_id, 'version', av.version, 'title', coalesce(av.title, ar.title), 'latestTitle', ar.title, 'summary', av.summary,
      'coverAttachmentId', av.cover_attachment_id,
      'latestVersion', (select max(av2.version) from artifact_version av2 where av2.artifact_id = av.artifact_id)))
    from artifact_version av join artifact ar on ar.id = av.artifact_id where av.attachment_id = a.id
  ), '{}'::jsonb)) order by a.attached_at, a.created_at)
  from attachment a where a.message_id = m.id
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as attachments,
  null::int as "replyCount",
  null::int as "activityCount",
  null::text as "lastReplyAt",
  null::uuid[] as "participantIds",
  null::int as "openAskHumanCount",
  null::text[] as "openAskAccountIds",

  case when m.deleted_at is null then (select json_build_object('status', ts.status, 'emoji', ts.emoji, 'accountId', ts.account_id,
    'reason', ts.reason, 'updatedAt', ts.updated_at) from thread_status ts where ts.root_id = m.id) end as "statusReaction",
  m.also_in_channel as "alsoInChannel", m.deleted_at as "deletedAt" from message m
               where m.channel_id = $1::uuid and m.thread_root_id = $2::uuid and m.seq > $3 and (m.deleted_at is null or (m.thread_root_id is null and exists (
  select 1 from message r
   where r.thread_root_id = m.id and r.deleted_at is null

            ) thread_window)
         ) window_rows

select * from (
           (select m.id, m.seq::int as seq, m.channel_id as "channelId", m.thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
  m.author_id as "authorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then m.body else '' end as body,
  m.kind, case when m.deleted_at is null then m.meta else '{}'::jsonb end as meta,
  m.created_at as "createdAt",
  m.edited_at as "editedAt",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg(json_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'accountIds', r."accountIds") order by r."firstAt")
  from (
    select emoji, array_agg(account_id::text order by created_at) as "accountIds",
           min(created_at) as "firstAt"
    from message_reaction where message_id = m.id group by emoji
  ) r
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as reactions,
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(
      'artifactId', av.artifact_id, 'version', av.version, 'title', coalesce(av.title, ar.title), 'latestTitle', ar.title, 'summary', av.summary,
      'coverAttachmentId', av.cover_attachment_id,
      'latestVersion', (select max(av2.version) from artifact_version av2 where av2.artifact_id = av.artifact_id)))
    from artifact_version av join artifact ar on ar.id = av.artifact_id where av.attachment_id = a.id
  ), '{}'::jsonb)) order by a.attached_at, a.created_at)
  from attachment a where a.message_id = m.id
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as attachments,
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.reply_count end as "replyCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.activity_count end as "activityCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.last_reply_at end as "lastReplyAt",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.participant_ids end as "participantIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.open_ask_human_count end as "openAskHumanCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.open_ask_account_ids end as "openAskAccountIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.open_gate_account_ids end as "openGateAccountIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.failure_count end as "failureCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.unresolved_failure_count end as "unresolvedFailureCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.open_ask_links end as "openAskLinks",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_last.last_kind end as "lastKind",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_last.last_author_id end as "lastAuthorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (select json_build_object('status', ts.status, 'emoji', ts.emoji, 'accountId', ts.account_id,
    'reason', ts.reason, 'updatedAt', ts.updated_at) from thread_status ts where ts.root_id = m.id) end as "statusReaction",
  m.also_in_channel as "alsoInChannel", m.deleted_at as "deletedAt" from message m LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kind NOT IN ('progress', 'wake'))::int as reply_count,
    COUNT(*)::int as activity_count,
    MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE kind NOT IN ('progress', 'wake'))::text as last_reply_at,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(author_id ORDER BY last_at DESC)
      FROM (
        SELECT author_id, MAX(created_at) as last_at
        FROM message
        WHERE thread_root_id = m.id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND author_id IS NOT NULL
          -- 시스템 줄의 author 는 참여자가 아니다(시스템 줄 C안 c3) — 승인 글을 쓴 사람·알림 대상 에이전트일 뿐이다.
          AND kind <> 'system'
          AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
        GROUP BY author_id
      ) recent
    ), '{}'::uuid[]) as participant_ids
  FROM message WHERE thread_root_id = m.id AND deleted_at IS NULL
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_stats ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    -- 특정 계정에게 간 미답 물음의 수신자들. 화면이 "이것이 내 차례인가"를 여기서 가른다.
    COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId') FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' IS NOT NULL
    ), '{}'::text[]) as open_ask_account_ids,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure')::int as failure_count,
    -- 마디들: 누가 → 누구를 기다리는가(#488 A3-b). 위의 두 집계로는 부족하다 —
    -- open_ask_account_ids 는 '답해야 하는 쪽'만 모은 집합이라 누가 물었는지가
    -- 지워지고, 사슬을 이으려면 짝이 필요하다.
    --
    -- ARRAY_AGG 가 아니라 JSONB_AGG 인 이유가 그것이다: 두 값을 한 행으로 묶어
    -- 내보내야 짝이 유지된다. 배열 둘로 내면 순서가 같다는 보장이 없다.
    --
    -- 'human' 은 blockedBy = null 로 낸다 — 계정 id 로 대신 채우면 그 사람만
    -- 기다리는 것처럼 보인다(open_ask_human_count 를 따로 둔 것과 같은 이유).
    COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(
      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'waiter', t.author_id::text,
        'blockedBy', CASE WHEN t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
          THEN t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' END,
        'askedAt', t.created_at
      ) ORDER BY t.seq
    ) FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.author_id IS NOT NULL
        -- 사람 아무나(human)와 특정 계정(account) 둘 다 마디가 된다. 그 밖의
        -- to.kind 는 화면이 이을 수 없으므로 넣지 않는다.
        AND (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'human'
          OR (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
            AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' IS NOT NULL))
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
    -- 위임 마디(3-3). 팀장이 기다리는 팀원 하나마다 한 마디다.
    --
    -- 물음과 같은 목록에 넣는 이유: 사슬을 잇는 walk() 는 마디의 출처를 묻지 않는다 —
    -- 누가 누구를 기다리는가 하나만 본다. 목록을 갈라 두 벌로 내면 화면이 그 둘을 합치는
    -- 코드를 또 쓰게 되고, 그 합치기가 스레드 안(메시지에서 만든 사슬)과 갈라진다.
    --
    -- 위임 하나가 여러 마디가 되므로(팀원 N 명) jsonb_array_elements_text 로 펼친다.
    -- ask 는 상대가 하나라 그 펼침이 없었고, 그래서 별도 집계가 필요하다.
    || COALESCE((
      SELECT JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('waiter', d.author_id::text, 'blockedBy', o.id, 'askedAt', d.created_at)
        ORDER BY d.seq
      )
      FROM message d, LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(d.meta->'delegation'->'open') AS o(id)
      WHERE (d.id = m.id OR d.thread_root_id = m.id) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND d.meta->>'kind' = 'delegation' AND d.author_id IS NOT NULL
        AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
    ), '[]'::jsonb) as open_ask_links
  FROM message t
  WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_state ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  -- **묶음·실패 판정은 후보 행에서만 센다**(2026-10-24, JIT 문턱). 아래 셋은 행마다 하위 질의(묶음 색인·뒤에 말이 있는가)를
  -- 부른다. 위 집계의 FILTER 안에 두면 CASE 덕에 실제로는 후보 행에서만 돌지만, 플래너는 그 비용을 스레드의 **모든 행**에
  -- 매긴다 — 머리 한 행이 수천~수만이 되어 목록 쿼리 하나가 jit_above_cost 를 몇십 배 넘었고, 실행 6ms 쿼리가 JIT 컴파일로
  -- 5초를 썼다(운영 측정, 스레드 답글 339). 종류 조건을 스캔의 WHERE 로 내리면 그 하위 질의는 걸러진 행 수만큼만 매겨진다.
  -- 뜻은 같다: 셋 다 kind 가 ask·askBundle·failure 가 아닌 행에서는 원래 FILTER 가 거짓이었다.
  SELECT
    -- 사람 아무나에게 간 미답 물음의 수. 누구인지 물을 수 없으므로 수로만 낸다.
    -- **closedAt 도 닫는다**(2026-09-09). 답하지 않기로 한 물음은 열려 있지 않다 — 이
    -- 조건이 없으면 사람이 그만두기로 한 뒤에도 대기 줄과 '내 차례' 배지가 남는다. 같은
    -- 판정이 shared::isAskOpen 에 있다(SQL 은 그 함수를 부를 수 없어 다시 적는다) —
    -- **필드가 늘면 두 자리를 함께 고친다.**
    -- **묶음 카드는 묶음 하나에 한 번 센다**(선택 카드 P1 3c, 2026-10-11). 묶음에 담긴 원본은 원 스레드에서 세지
    -- 않고, 열린 줄을 가진 묶음 카드가 그 묶음 스레드에서 하나로 선다 — 같은 결정이 🙋·Inbox 에 두 번 서지 않게.
    -- 판정은 askBundleSql.ts 하나(threadStatus 의 FACTS_SQL 과 같은 조각).
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'human'
        AND NOT (CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask' THEN (
        NOT (t.meta ? 'permissionRequest' OR t.meta ? 'mergeDenial')
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message bnd
            JOIN channel bc ON bc.id = bnd.channel_id
           WHERE bnd.meta->>'kind' = 'askBundle' AND bnd.deleted_at IS NULL
             AND bc.kind = 'standard' AND bc.visibility = 'public' AND bc.archived_at IS NULL
             AND bnd.meta->'askBundle'->'items' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('rootId', t.id::text)))) ELSE false END)
    ) + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'askBundle' THEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM message br
         WHERE br.id = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE
            WHEN bi->>'rootId' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
            THEN (bi->>'rootId')::uuid END
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.meta->'askBundle'->'items') bi))
           AND br.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND br.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
