    -- 그 뒤에 에이전트가 다시 붙어 진행 설명을 올리고 있어도 영원히 붉게 남는다 — 사람이
    -- 보는 화면에서 "작업 중"이 계속 "막힘"으로 뒤집히던 것이 이것이다.
    --
    -- 해소의 정의: **그 실패보다 뒤에 에이전트의 말이 있으면 풀린 것이다.** 에이전트의
    -- 말이란 (a) 진행 설명·대기 줄(kind), (b) 완료 보고(meta.kind), (c) **그 실패를 낸
    -- 계정 자신의 아무 말**이다. (c) 가 필요한 이유는 마지막 답을 평범한 글로 내는 러너가
    -- 있어서고, 그때 그 계정이 에이전트라는 것은 실패를 낸 자가 그 계정이라는 사실이
    -- 이미 말해 준다 — account 를 조인하지 않고도 안다.
    --
    -- 사람이 되묻는 말은 풀지 않는다. 그때는 정말로 막혀 있는 것이고, 그것을 '끝남'으로
    -- 칠하는 것이 이 필드가 막으려는 반대쪽 거짓말이다.
    --
    -- **CASE 로 감싼다**(2026-10-13 쿼리 개선 Q1). 집계의 FILTER 안 AND 는 적힌 순서대로 끊기지 않아, 이 하위 질의가
    -- 실패가 아닌 행에서도 돌았다 — 보드 머리 한 번에 스레드의 모든 행만큼(로컬 17,543번·11.5만 블록). CASE 는 평가 순서를
    -- 약속한다. 아래 open_gate_account_ids 도 같다.
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure' THEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message r
          WHERE (r.id = m.id OR r.thread_root_id = m.id)
            AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND r.seq > t.seq
            AND (r.kind IN ('progress', 'wake')
              OR r.meta->>'kind' = 'report'
              OR r.author_id = t.author_id)
        ) ELSE false END
    )::int as unresolved_failure_count,
    -- 안 풀린 account_gate 실패의 차례 주인들(2026-10-02). 해소 규칙은 바로 위와 **같다** —
    -- 갈라지면 🙋 가 풀린 뒤에도 Inbox 의 내 차례에 남는다. 차례 주인을 못 정한 실패
    -- (awaitingAccountId 없음)는 넣지 않는다: 아무 계정 id 로 채우면 그 사람만 강조를 받는다.
    COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.meta->'failure'->>'awaitingAccountId') FILTER (
      WHERE CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure'
        AND t.meta->'failure'->>'code' = 'account_gate'
        AND t.meta->'failure'->>'awaitingAccountId' IS NOT NULL
        THEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message r
          WHERE (r.id = m.id OR r.thread_root_id = m.id)
            AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND r.seq > t.seq
            AND (r.kind IN ('progress', 'wake')
              OR r.meta->>'kind' = 'report'
              OR r.author_id = t.author_id)
        ) ELSE false END
    ), '{}'::text[]) as open_gate_account_ids
  FROM message t
  WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND t.meta->>'kind' IN ('ask', 'askBundle', 'failure')
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_open ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  -- 마지막 말 하나. 그것이 진행이고 저자가 살아 있는 에이전트일 때만 '도는 중'이므로,
  -- 화면은 이 둘(kind·저자)에 자기가 아는 생존을 곱해 판정한다.
  --
  -- 「가장 최근의 살아 있는 답글」과 「루트 자신」 둘 중 seq 가 큰 것이다(2026-10-13 쿼리 개선 Q4). 예전 꼴
  -- WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1 은 OR 때문에 색인 순서를 못 써서
  -- 스레드 전체를 모아 정렬했다(답글 2,600개 스레드면 2,600행 정렬). 답글 쪽은 (thread_root_id, seq) 색인을
  -- 거꾸로 한 줄만 읽고, 루트는 이미 손에 있는 m 이다. 둘을 seq 로 견주므로 뜻은 같다.
  SELECT x.kind as last_kind, x.author_id as last_author_id
  FROM (
    (SELECT t.kind, t.author_id::text as author_id, t.seq
       FROM message t
      WHERE t.thread_root_id = m.id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
        -- 시스템 줄은 누구의 말도 아니다 — 「마지막 말」에서 뺀다(시스템 줄 C안 c3).
        AND t.kind <> 'system'
        -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
        AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
      ORDER BY t.seq DESC LIMIT 1)
    UNION ALL
    (SELECT m.kind, m.author_id::text, m.seq
      WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL)
  ) x
  ORDER BY x.seq DESC LIMIT 1
) thread_last ON true
     where m.thread_root_id is null
  )
  select m.id, m.seq::int as seq, m.channel_id as "channelId", m.thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
  m.author_id as "authorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then m.body else '' end as body,
  m.kind, case when m.deleted_at is null then m.meta else '{}'::jsonb end as meta,
  m.created_at as "createdAt",
  m.edited_at as "editedAt",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg(json_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'accountIds', r."accountIds") order by r."firstAt")
  from (
    select emoji, array_agg(account_id::text order by created_at) as "accountIds",
           min(created_at) as "firstAt"
    from message_reaction where message_id = m.id group by emoji
  ) r
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as reactions,
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(

search_messages_relevance:
select m.id, m.seq::int as seq, m.channel_id as "channelId", m.thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
       m.author_id as "authorId", m.body, m.kind, m.meta, m.created_at as "createdAt",
       m.edited_at as "editedAt", '[]'::json as reactions,
       -- 결과 카드가 사진·파일을 그릴 수 있게 첨부 요약을 싣는다(S1). 이 하위 질의는 **아래 where 를
       -- 통과한 행**(볼 수 있고 지워지지 않은 메시지)에만 붙으므로 못 보는 메시지의 첨부를 끌어오지
       -- 않는다(security S1 ③). 모양은 목록 응답과 같은 ATTACHMENTS 한 곳에서 온다.
       coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(
      'artifactId', av.artifact_id, 'version', av.version, 'title', coalesce(av.title, ar.title), 'latestTitle', ar.title, 'summary', av.summary,
      'coverAttachmentId', av.cover_attachment_id,
      'latestVersion', (select max(av2.version) from artifact_version av2 where av2.artifact_id = av.artifact_id)))
    from artifact_version av join artifact ar on ar.id = av.artifact_id where av.attachment_id = a.id
  ), '{}'::jsonb)) order by a.attached_at, a.created_at)
  from attachment a where a.message_id = m.id
), '[]'::json) as attachments,
       null::int as "replyCount", null::int as "activityCount",
  null::text as "lastReplyAt", null::text[] as "participantIds",
       m.also_in_channel as "alsoInChannel"
     from message m
     join channel c on c.id = m.channel_id
     where (
      m.search @@ nullif(
      regexp_replace(websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1)::text, '''(\s|$)', ''':*\1', 'g'), ''
    )::tsquery
      or (
        char_length($1) >= 3
        and lower(m.body) like '%' || replace(replace(replace(lower($1), '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%'
      )
    ) and m.deleted_at is null
       -- 진행 줄(progress)·대기 줄(wake)은 사람이 찾는 **말**이 아니다. 답글 수에서
       -- 뺀 것과 **같은 목록**이다(shared::countsAsReply) — 종류가 늘면 두 자리를 같이 고친다.
       -- 여기 없으면 에이전트 진행 줄이 본문 결과를 밀어낸다(상위 N 건에서 잘리므로
       -- 정작 찾던 말이 응답에 애초에 안 들어온다).
       and m.kind not in ('progress', 'wake')
       -- 검색은 채널 목록을 우회해 본문에 바로 닿는 표면이다. 여기만 넓으면 목록에도
       -- 배지에도 없는 private 채널의 발언이 검색 결과로 통째로 나온다 — 그래서 목록·배지와
       -- **같은 술어**를 쓴다. admin 예외 없다(결과가 곧 메시지 본문이다).
       and ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = $3::uuid))
       -- 스코프는 가시성 **위에** 얹는 별개 조건이다. null 이면 절이 상수로 접혀 전역 검색의
       -- 계획이 그대로 남는다 — 기존 동작을 건드리지 않는다.
       and ($4::uuid is null or m.channel_id = $4::uuid)
       -- 스레드 스코프는 루트 자신을 포함한다 — 루트에 있는 말을 못 찾으면 "이 스레드에서
       -- 찾기"가 아니다(listMessages 의 스레드 분기와 같은 문장).
       and ($5::uuid is null or m.id = $5::uuid or m.thread_root_id = $5::uuid)
       -- 거르기(S1)도 같은 자리다: 가시성·스코프 **위에** 얹는 and 뿐이라 결과를 좁히기만 한다
       -- (security S1 ①). null 이면 상수로 접혀 계획이 그대로 남는다.
       and ($7::uuid[] is null or m.author_id = any($7::uuid[]))
       and ($8::timestamptz is null or m.created_at >= $8::timestamptz)
       and ($9::timestamptz is null or m.created_at < $9::timestamptz)
       and ($10::boolean is not true or exists (select 1 from attachment a where a.message_id = m.id))
     -- 정확 일치(1번)를 부분문자열-only 히트 앞에 세우고, 그 안에서 ts_rank, 그다음 최신순.
     -- seq desc 만 있던 때는 흔한 낱말이면 상위 50 이 전부 최근 것으로 차서 정작 찾던
     -- 옛 메시지가 응답에 들어오지도 않았다.
     --
     -- 페이지는 offset 이다(seq 커서가 아니다): 순서가 seq 가 아니라 rank 이므로 seq 커서는
     -- 이 정렬에서 뜻이 없다.
     order by (m.search @@ nullif(
      regexp_replace(websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1)::text, '''(\s|$)', ''':*\1', 'g'), ''
    )::tsquery) desc,
              ts_rank(m.search, nullif(
      regexp_replace(websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1)::text, '''(\s|$)', ''':*\1', 'g'), ''
    )::tsquery) desc,
              m.seq desc
     limit $2 offset $6

post_idempotency_find:
select message_id from idempotency_key
         where key = $1 and author_id = $2::uuid and channel_id = $3::uuid
post_insert:
insert into message (channel_id, thread_root_id, author_id, body, kind, meta, also_in_channel, mention_depth, cause_message_id, stall_depth, chain_started_at)
       values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7::bool, $8::int, $9::uuid, $10::int, $11::timestamptz) returning id
post_thread_root_of: select 1 from message where id = $1::uuid and channel_id = $2::uuid and thread_root_id is null
post_root_author: select author_id, deleted_at from message where id = $1::uuid
post_idempotency_insert: insert into idempotency_key (key, message_id, author_id, channel_id) values ($1, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::uuid)
post_channel_kind: select kind from channel where id = $1::uuid
post_dm_peers: select account_id from channel_member where channel_id = $1::uuid and account_id <> $2::uuid
attach_find: select id, uploader_id, message_id from attachment where id = any($1::uuid[]) for update
mandate_own_agent:
select 1 from agent_config c join account a on a.id = c.account_id
        where c.account_id = any($1::uuid[]) and c.owner_account_id = $2::uuid and a.kind = 'agent' limit 1
mandate_root_insert:
insert into mandate (owner_account_id, delegator_account_id, root_message_id, channel_id, thread_root_id, created_at, last_activity_at)
       values ($1::uuid, $5::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $2::uuid, $4::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz)
       on conflict (root_message_id) do update set last_activity_at = excluded.last_activity_at
       returning id, (xmax = 0) as inserted
mandate_delegated_agents:
select c.account_id as id from agent_config c join account a on a.id = c.account_id
      where c.account_id = any($1::uuid[]) and a.kind = 'agent' and c.owner_account_id is not null
      order by array_position($1::uuid[], c.account_id)
message_set_mandate: update message set mandate_id = $2::uuid where id = $1::uuid
mandate_reply_continue:
update mandate d set last_activity_at = greatest(d.last_activity_at, $3::timestamptz)
         from message r
        where r.id = $1::uuid and d.id = r.mandate_id and d.ended_at is null
          and (d.owner_account_id = $2::uuid or coalesce(d.delegator_account_id, d.owner_account_id) = $2::uuid)
        returning d.id
mandate_keyless_own:
select 1 from agent_config c join account a on a.id = c.account_id
      where c.account_id = any($1::uuid[]) and c.owner_account_id = $2::uuid and a.kind = 'agent' limit 1
mandate_keyless_root:
select m.mandate_id as "mandateId",
            (m.author_id = $3::uuid or exists (select 1 from agent_config c where c.account_id = m.author_id and c.owner_account_id = $3::uuid)) as "ownAuthor"
       from message m
      where m.id = $1::uuid and m.channel_id = $2::uuid and m.thread_root_id is null and m.deleted_at is null
        -- ⑤b(security 4): 자동화 회차 글은 뿌리가 되지 않는다 — 회차 글에는 키를 적지 않는다.
        and not (coalesce(m.meta, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'automation')
      for update of m
mandate_keyless_touch:
update mandate set last_activity_at = greatest(last_activity_at, $3::timestamptz)
        where id = $1::uuid and owner_account_id = $2::uuid and ended_at is null returning id
mandate_keyless_insert:
insert into mandate (owner_account_id, delegator_account_id, root_message_id, channel_id, thread_root_id, created_at, last_activity_at)
     values ($1::uuid, $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $2::uuid, $4::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz)
     on conflict (root_message_id) do nothing
     returning id
mandate_keyless_find: select id from mandate where root_message_id = $1::uuid and owner_account_id = $2::uuid and ended_at is null
mandate_keyless_root_set: update message set mandate_id = $2::uuid where id = $1::uuid and mandate_id is null
preempt_due:
select w.id, w.account_id, w.message_id, m.meta->'wake'->'reportTo' as report_to from agent_wake w
       join message m on m.id = w.message_id
      where coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id) = $1::uuid
        and w.account_id <> $2::uuid
        and w.fired_at is null
        and w.canceled_at is null
      order by w.wake_at
      for update of w
preempt_cancel: update agent_wake set canceled_at = now(), canceled_by_message_id = $2::uuid where id = $1::uuid
preempt_fire_inbox:

       select w.account_id, w.message_id, 'wake' from agent_wake w where w.id = $1::uuid
preempt_fire: update agent_wake set fired_at = now() where id = $1::uuid
stamp_wake_closed:
update message set meta = jsonb_set(meta, array['wake', $3::text], to_jsonb($2::text))
      where id = any($1::uuid[]) and jsonb_typeof(meta->'wake') = 'object' and meta->'wake'->>($3::text) is null
cancel_as_delegate:

       join team_delegation d on d.id = i.delegation_id
      where i.delegate_account_id = $1::uuid and i.outcome is null and d.thread_root_id = $2::uuid
      order by d.created_at
      for update of d
cancel_delegate_item:
update team_delegation_item set outcome = 'canceled', closed_at = now()
        where delegation_id = $1::uuid and delegate_account_id = $2::uuid and outcome is null
cancel_as_lead:
select id::text as id from team_delegation
      where lead_account_id = $1::uuid and thread_root_id = $2::uuid and notified_at is null
      for update
cancel_lead_items:
update team_delegation_item set outcome = 'canceled', closed_at = now()
        where delegation_id = $1::uuid and outcome is null
cancel_lead_meta:
update message m set meta = jsonb_set(m.meta::jsonb, '{delegation,open}', '[]'::jsonb)
         from team_delegation d
        where d.id = $1::uuid and m.id = d.message_id and m.meta->>'kind' = 'delegation'
cancel_lead_mark: update team_delegation set notified_at = now() where id = $1::uuid
settled_still:
select delegate_account_id::text as delegate_account_id from team_delegation_item
      where delegation_id = $1::uuid and outcome is null
      order by delegate_account_id
settled_meta:
update message m
        set meta = jsonb_set(m.meta::jsonb, '{delegation,open}', $2::jsonb)
       from team_delegation d
      where d.id = $1::uuid and m.id = d.message_id and m.meta->>'kind' = 'delegation'
settled_mark:
update team_delegation set notified_at = now()
      where id = $1::uuid and notified_at is null
      returning lead_account_id::text as lead_account_id, message_id::text as message_id, thread_root_id::text as thread_root_id
settled_inbox: insert into inbox (account_id, message_id, reason) values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'delegation_done')
fold_wakes_for_delegation:
update agent_wake w set canceled_at = now(), canceled_by_message_id = $4::uuid
       from message m
      where m.id = w.message_id
        and w.account_id = $2::uuid
        and w.fired_at is null
        and w.canceled_at is null
        and (m.meta->'wake'->>'delegationId' = $1::text
          or (not (m.meta->'wake' ? 'delegationId')
              and coalesce(lower(m.meta->'wake'->'reportTo'->>'threadRootId'), coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id)::text) = $3::text))
      returning m.meta->'wake'->'reportTo' as report_to, m.id::text as message_id
fold_wakes_on_report:
update agent_wake w set canceled_at = now()
       from message m
      where m.id = w.message_id
        and w.account_id = $2::uuid
        and w.fired_at is null
        and w.canceled_at is null
        and (coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id) = $1::uuid
          or coalesce(lower(m.meta->'wake'->'reportTo'->>'threadRootId'), coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id)::text) = lower($3::text))
        and ($4::text is null or m.meta->>'turnId' is distinct from $4::text)
      returning w.id::text as id,
        to_char(w.wake_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as wake_at,
        w.message_id::text as message_id, m.body, m.deleted_at is not null as deleted, m.meta->'wake'->'reportTo' as report_to,
        coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id)::text as thread_root_id
wake_consecutive:
select count(*)::int as n from message
      where thread_root_id = $1::uuid and author_id = $2::uuid and kind = 'wake'
        and seq > coalesce((
          select max(seq) from message where thread_root_id = $1::uuid and author_id <> $2::uuid
        ), 0)
wake_delegation_held: select 1 from team_delegation where id = $1::uuid and lead_account_id = $2::uuid and notified_at is null
wake_insert:
insert into agent_wake (account_id, channel_id, message_id, wake_at, mandate_id)
       values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::timestamptz, (select mandate_id from message where id = $3::uuid)) returning id::text as id
wake_open_watch_report_to:
select m.meta->'wake'->'reportTo' as report_to from agent_wake w, message m
      where m.id = w.message_id
        and w.account_id = $2::uuid
        and w.fired_at is null
        and w.canceled_at is null
        and m.meta->'wake'->>'watch' = 'true'
        and coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id) = $1::uuid and m.meta->'wake' ? 'reportTo'
      order by m.seq desc limit 1
wake_replace_watch:
update agent_wake w set canceled_at = now()
       from message m
      where m.id = w.message_id
        and w.account_id = $2::uuid
        and w.fired_at is null
        and w.canceled_at is null
        and m.meta->'wake'->>'watch' = 'true'
        and (coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id) = $1::uuid
          or coalesce(lower(m.meta->'wake'->'reportTo'->>'threadRootId'), coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id)::text) = lower($3::text)) and w.id <> $4::uuid
      returning w.id::text as id,
        to_char(w.wake_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as wake_at,
        w.message_id::text as message_id, m.body, m.deleted_at is not null as deleted, m.meta->'wake'->'reportTo' as report_to,
        coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id)::text as thread_root_id
wake_report_head: select 1 from message where id = $1::uuid and channel_id = $2::uuid and thread_root_id is null and deleted_at is null
watch_origin_cause: select kind, meta->'wake'->>'watch' = 'true' as watch, meta->'wake'->>'origin' as origin from message where id = $1::uuid
watch_origin_ok:
select 1 from message
      where id = $1::uuid and channel_id = $2::uuid and (id = $3::uuid or thread_root_id = $3::uuid)
        and deleted_at is null and kind not in ('wake', 'system', 'progress')
cancel_wakes_for_turn:
update agent_wake w set canceled_at = now()
       from message m
      where m.id = w.message_id
        and coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id) = $1::uuid
        and w.account_id = $2::uuid
        and w.fired_at is null
        and w.canceled_at is null
      returning m.meta->'wake'->'reportTo' as report_to, m.id::text as message_id
ask_close_by_reply:
update message
          set meta = jsonb_set(
                jsonb_set(
                  jsonb_set(
                    jsonb_set(meta::jsonb, '{ask,closedAt}', to_jsonb(now())),
                    '{ask,closedBy}', to_jsonb($4::text)),
                  '{ask,closedReason}', to_jsonb('replied'::text)),
                '{ask,replyMessageId}', to_jsonb($5::text))
        where (id = $1::uuid or thread_root_id = $1::uuid)
          and channel_id = $2::uuid
          and seq < $3::bigint
          and deleted_at is null
          and meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
          and meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' is null
          and meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' is null
          and meta->'ask'->>'mirrorOf' is null
          and not (meta ? 'permissionRequest')
          and not (meta ? 'mergeDenial')
          and (meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'human'
            or (meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account' and meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' = $4))
        returning id, seq::int as seq, channel_id as "channelId", thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
  author_id as "authorId", body, kind, meta, created_at as "createdAt",
  edited_at as "editedAt", coalesce((
  select json_agg(json_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'accountIds', r."accountIds") order by r."firstAt")
  from (
    select emoji, array_agg(account_id::text order by created_at) as "accountIds",
           min(created_at) as "firstAt"
    from message_reaction where message_id = message.id group by emoji
  ) r
), '[]'::json) as reactions, coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(
      'artifactId', av.artifact_id, 'version', av.version, 'title', coalesce(av.title, ar.title), 'latestTitle', ar.title, 'summary', av.summary,
      'coverAttachmentId', av.cover_attachment_id,
      'latestVersion', (select max(av2.version) from artifact_version av2 where av2.artifact_id = av.artifact_id)))
    from artifact_version av join artifact ar on ar.id = av.artifact_id where av.attachment_id = a.id
  ), '{}'::jsonb)) order by a.attached_at, a.created_at)
  from attachment a where a.message_id = message.id
), '[]'::json) as attachments,
  null::int as "replyCount", null::int as "activityCount",
  null::text as "lastReplyAt", null::text[] as "participantIds",
  null::int as "openAskHumanCount", null::text[] as "openAskAccountIds", null::jsonb as "openAskLinks",
  null::text[] as "openGateAccountIds",
  null::int as "failureCount", null::int as "unresolvedFailureCount",
  null::text as "lastKind", null::text as "lastAuthorId",
  (select json_build_object('status', ts.status, 'emoji', ts.emoji, 'accountId', ts.account_id,
    'reason', ts.reason, 'updatedAt', ts.updated_at) from thread_status ts where ts.root_id = message.id) as "statusReaction",
  also_in_channel as "alsoInChannel", deleted_at as "deletedAt"
delegation_touch_deadline:
update team_delegation d
        set deadline_at = greatest(d.deadline_at, now() + ($3::int * interval '1 second'))
       from team_delegation_item i
      where i.delegation_id = d.id
        and i.delegate_account_id = $1::uuid
        and i.outcome is null
        and d.thread_root_id = $2::uuid
        and d.notified_at is null
reply_grant_open:
insert into invoke_reply_grant (grantee_id, granter_id, thread_root_id, expires_at)
     select g.id, $1::uuid, $2::uuid, now() + make_interval(secs => $4::int)
       from account g
      where g.id = any($3::uuid[]) and g.kind = 'agent'
        and exists (
          select 1 from account a join agent_config c on c.account_id = a.id
           where a.id = $1::uuid and a.kind = 'agent' and c.invoke_scope <> 'community')
     on conflict (grantee_id, granter_id, thread_root_id) do update
       set opened_at = now(), expires_at = excluded.expires_at, closed_at = null
reply_grant_close:
update invoke_reply_grant set closed_at = now()
      where grantee_id = $1::uuid and thread_root_id = $2::uuid and closed_at is null
mention_depth_scan:
select m.body, m.mention_depth as depth, m.stall_depth as stall, (a.kind = 'agent') as author_is_agent,
            m.created_at, m.chain_started_at,
            -- **실제로 나를 깨운 부름만 고리다**(2026-09-29). 본문만 다시 파싱하면 상한에
            -- 막혔거나(capped) 호출 범위에 거절된(denied) 부름도 "나를 부른 메시지"로 보여,
            -- 깨운 적 없는 부름이 깊이를 쌓았다. 그 부름으로 inbox 가 생겼는지를 함께 본다.
            -- thread_reply·wake 같은 사유는 부름이 아니므로 세지 않는다.
            exists (select 1 from inbox i
                     where i.message_id = m.id and i.account_id = $3::uuid
                       and i.reason in ('mention', 'dm', 'team_mention', 'team_delegated')) as woke
       from message m join account a on a.id = m.author_id
      where m.channel_id = $1::uuid
        -- **스레드 경계를 양쪽 다 지킨다**(2026-09-14).
        --
        -- 앞 판본은 두 번째 인자가 null 이면 이 조건을 통째로 비웠다 — 그래서 **새 채널
        -- 최상위** 발화가 채널의 다른 스레드에서 나를 부른 답을 앞 고리로 물려받았다.
        -- 무관한 새 대화인데 깊이가 3~4로 시작해 곧바로 상한에 걸렸고, 사람이 새 턴을
        -- 띄워 줘도 소용없었다(깊이가 내 턴이 아니라 채널 이력에서 왔으므로).
        --
        -- 최상위 발화는 **최상위 발화들끼리만** 고리로 본다. A·B 가 최상위로 서로를
        -- 부르며 도는 폭주는 그대로 잡히고(그 발화들도 최상위다), 다른 스레드의 옛
        -- 부름은 더 이상 새 대화의 앞 고리가 아니다.
        and (case when $2::uuid is null
                  then m.thread_root_id is null
                  else m.thread_root_id = $2::uuid or m.id = $2::uuid end)
        and m.deleted_at is null
      order by m.seq desc
      limit 50
stall_recent_bodies:
select m.body from message m
      where m.channel_id = $1::uuid
        and (case when $2::uuid is null
                  then m.thread_root_id is null
                  else m.thread_root_id = $2::uuid or m.id = $2::uuid end)
        and m.deleted_at is null
      order by m.seq desc
      limit 10
stall_own_thread_links:
select m.id::text as id from message m
      where m.id = any($1::uuid[]) and m.channel_id = $2::uuid
        and (case when $3::uuid is null
                  then m.thread_root_id is null
                  else m.thread_root_id = $3::uuid or m.id = $3::uuid end)
stall_shadow: select id::text as id from account where id = any($1::uuid[]) and kind = 'agent' and deleted_at is null
cause_depth:
with card as (
       select exists (select 1 from inbox i join account h
                        on h.id::text = case i.reason when 'ask_answered' then m.meta->'ask'->>'answeredBy'
                                                      else m.meta->'ask'->>'closedBy' end
                       where i.message_id = m.id and i.account_id = $2::uuid
                         and i.reason in ('ask_answered', 'ask_closed') and h.kind = 'human'
                         -- 백스톱 카드(147, security n3)는 사람이 원본을 직접 눌러 「계속」을 고른 답만 사슬을 새로 시작한다.
                         -- 「멈춤」·닫힘·거울·일괄·글로 고른 답은 리셋하지 않는다 — 깊이가 그대로라 부름은 계속 막힌다.
                         and (not (m.meta ? 'chainBackstop')
                              or (i.reason = 'ask_answered'
                                  and m.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' = 'continue'
                                  and m.meta->'ask'->>'mirrorOf' is null
                                  and m.meta->'ask'->>'answeredVia' is null))) as by_human
         from message m where m.id = $1::uuid
     )
     select m.mention_depth as depth, m.stall_depth as stall, (a.kind = 'agent') as author_is_agent,
            m.created_at, m.chain_started_at,
            (m.meta ? 'automation') as from_automation, card.by_human as human_card
       from message m join account a on a.id = m.author_id cross join card
      where m.id = $1::uuid and m.deleted_at is null
        and (card.by_human
             or exists (select 1 from inbox i
                         where i.message_id = m.id and i.account_id = $2::uuid
                           and (i.reason in ('mention', 'dm', 'team_mention', 'team_delegated', 'delegation_followup')
                                or (a.kind = 'human' and i.reason in ('thread_reply', 'ask_answered')))))
cause_verified_link:
select m.id::text as id from message m
      where m.id = $1::uuid and m.deleted_at is null
        -- 후속 보고로 깬 턴은 사슬 고리를 잇지 않는다 — 머지 사슬이 이 자동 깨움을 타고 사람 권한을 나르지 않게.
        and exists (select 1 from inbox i where i.message_id = m.id and i.account_id = $2::uuid and i.created_at > $3::timestamptz and i.reason <> 'delegation_followup')
cause_principal:
select p.id::text as id from secret_turn_lease l
       join account p on p.id = l.principal_account_id
       join message m on m.id = l.cause_message_id and m.deleted_at is null
      where l.agent_id = $1::uuid and l.cause_message_id = $2::uuid and l.ended_at is null and l.expires_at > $3::timestamptz
        and p.kind = 'human' and p.deleted_at is null and p.disabled_at is null
      order by l.created_at desc limit 1
cause_reasons: select distinct reason from inbox where account_id = $1::uuid and message_id = $2::uuid order by reason
cause_mandate:
select d.id::text as id from secret_turn_lease l
       join mandate d on d.id = l.mandate_id
       join agent_config c on c.account_id = l.agent_id
       join message m on m.id = l.cause_message_id and m.deleted_at is null
      where l.agent_id = $1::uuid and l.cause_message_id = $2::uuid and l.ended_at is null and l.expires_at > $3::timestamptz
        and c.owner_account_id = d.owner_account_id
      order by l.created_at desc limit 1
effective_model:
select coalesce(nullif(t.model, ''), nullif(c.model, ''), nullif(d.model, '')) as model
       from agent_config c
       left join agent_defaults d on true
       left join thread_agent_model t
         on t.agent_id = c.account_id and t.thread_root_id = $2::uuid and t.harness = c.harness
      where c.account_id = $1::uuid
implicit_agent_callees: select id::text from account where id = any($1::uuid[]) and kind = 'agent'
implicit_plan: select doc from thread_plan where root_id = $1::uuid and flag_reason is null
implicit_verdict:
select case when i.delegate_account_id = $3::uuid then 'same' else 'reverse' end as dir
       from team_delegation d
       join team_delegation_item i on i.delegation_id = d.id
      where d.thread_root_id = $1::uuid
        and (i.outcome is null or i.outcome = 'reported')
        and (i.delegate_account_id = $3::uuid
          or (d.lead_account_id = $3::uuid and i.delegate_account_id = $2::uuid))
     union all
     select case when l.delegate_account_id = $3::uuid then 'same' else 'reverse' end
       from delegation_implicit_log l
      where l.thread_root_id = $1::uuid and l.verdict = 'open' and l.mode = 'shadow'
        and l.created_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $4::int)
        and (l.delegate_account_id = $3::uuid
          or (l.delegator_account_id = $3::uuid and l.delegate_account_id = $2::uuid))
implicit_log_insert:
insert into delegation_implicit_log
         (message_id, channel_id, thread_root_id, delegator_account_id, delegate_account_id, verdict, mode,
          plan_step_id, short_question, body_chars, delegation_id)
       values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::uuid, $5::uuid, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10::int, $11::uuid)
delegation_insert:
insert into team_delegation
       (message_id, team_id, lead_account_id, channel_id, thread_root_id, deadline_at, kind, plan_step_id)
     values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::uuid, $5::uuid, $6::timestamptz, $7, $8)
     returning id::text
chain_backstop_owner:
select c.owner_account_id::text as "ownerId", a.handle
       from account a join agent_config c on c.account_id = a.id join account o on o.id = c.owner_account_id
      where a.id = $1::uuid and o.kind = 'human' and o.deleted_at is null and o.disabled_at is null
chain_backstop_open:
select id::text as id from message
      where channel_id = $1::uuid and coalesce(thread_root_id, id) = $2::uuid and deleted_at is null
        and meta ? 'chainBackstop'
        and meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' is null and meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' is null
      order by seq desc limit 1
enqueue_ask_push:
insert into push_job (account_id, message_id, reason)
     select $1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'ask'
      where exists (select 1 from account where id = $1::uuid and kind = 'human')
        and exists (select 1 from push_device where account_id = $1::uuid)
        -- 차단(109) — inbox 를 거치지 않는 길이라 insertInbox 의 거름을 여기서도 건다.
        and not exists (
          select 1 from account_block b join message m on m.id = $2::uuid
           where b.blocker_id = $1::uuid and b.blocked_id = m.author_id)
delegation_v2_update_pending:
update team_delegation_item i
        set last_activity_at = now(), update_pending_message_id = $3::uuid, update_pending_at = now()
       from team_delegation d
      where d.id = i.delegation_id and d.thread_root_id = $2::uuid and i.delegate_account_id = $1::uuid
        and (i.outcome is null or i.outcome = 'reported')
close_reply_open:
select i.delegation_id::text as delegation_id
       from team_delegation_item i
       join team_delegation d on d.id = i.delegation_id
      where i.delegate_account_id = $1::uuid and i.outcome is null and d.thread_root_id = $2::uuid
      order by d.created_at
      for update of d
close_reply_item_v0:
update team_delegation_item
          set outcome = $3::text, closed_by_message_id = $4::uuid, closed_at = now()
        where delegation_id = $1::uuid and delegate_account_id = $2::uuid and outcome is null
close_reply_item_v2:
update team_delegation_item
            set outcome = $3::text, closed_by_message_id = $4::uuid, closed_at = now(), last_activity_at = now(),
                update_pending_message_id = null, update_pending_at = null
          where delegation_id = $1::uuid and delegate_account_id = $2::uuid and outcome is null
decider_row:
select c.owner_account_id as "ownerAccountId", coalesce(c.invoke_scope, 'community') as scope, c.user_decide as "userDecide",
            (a.disabled_at is not null or a.deleted_at is not null) as "agentOff",
            p.kind as "actorKind", p.role as "actorRole", (p.disabled_at is not null or p.deleted_at is not null) as "actorOff"
       from agent_config c join account a on a.id = c.account_id
       left join account p on p.id = $2::uuid
      where c.account_id = $1::uuid
decider_seen:
select ((ch.kind = 'standard' and ch.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = ch.id and cm_vis.account_id = $2::uuid)) as ok from channel ch where ch.id = $1::uuid
decider_list: select 1 from agent_invoker where agent_id = $1::uuid and account_id = $2::uuid
decider_channel:
select 1 from channel_member m join channel ch on ch.id = m.channel_id
          where m.channel_id = $1::uuid and m.account_id = $2::uuid and ch.kind <> 'dm'
bundle_read:
select id, meta, channel_id as "channelId", thread_root_id as "threadRootId", author_id as "authorId"
       from message where id = $1::uuid and deleted_at is null
bundle_decision_card: select 1 from message where id = $1::uuid and (meta ? 'permissionRequest' or meta ? 'mergeDenial')
bundle_accept_root: select meta, body from message where id = $1::uuid and deleted_at is null
bundle_item_root:
select meta, body, channel_id as "channelId", thread_root_id as "threadRootId", author_id as "authorId"
       from message where id = $1::uuid and deleted_at is null
bundle_items_update:
update message set meta = jsonb_set(meta::jsonb, '{askBundle,items}', $2::jsonb)
      where id = $1::uuid and deleted_at is null
gate_awaiting:
select m.author_id::text as author_id
       from inbox i
       join message m on m.id = i.message_id
       join account a on a.id = m.author_id
       join channel c on c.id = m.channel_id
      where i.account_id = $1::uuid and i.message_id = $2::uuid and m.channel_id = $3::uuid
        and a.kind = 'human' and m.deleted_at is null
        and ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = m.author_id))
      limit 1
bundle_push:
insert into push_job (account_id, message_id, reason, not_before)
     select $1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'ask', now() + make_interval(secs => $3::int)
      where exists (select 1 from account where id = $1::uuid and kind = 'human')
        and exists (select 1 from push_device where account_id = $1::uuid)
        -- 사유를 가리지 않는다 — 그 묶음 글이 이미 답글·멘션 푸시로 나갈 참이면 둘째 알림을 얹지 않는다.
        and not exists (select 1 from push_job j where j.account_id = $1::uuid and j.message_id = $2::uuid)
        and not exists (
          select 1 from account_block b join message m on m.id = $2::uuid
           where b.blocker_id = $1::uuid and b.blocked_id = m.author_id)
list_inbox_unread:
select i.id::int as id, i.message_id as "messageId", i.reason, i.read_at as "readAt",
            m.channel_id as "channelId",
            -- 줄이 네 가지를 말할 재료(#488 C2): 누가 · 무슨 말 · 무엇을 · 언제·어디.
            -- 이미 message 를 join 하고 있었으므로 컬럼만 더한다 — 새 왕복이 없다.
            -- 시스템 메시지의 자리표시자는 여기서 채운다 — 인박스 항목에는 kind 가 없어 화면이 못 채운다.
            m.author_id as "authorId", case when m.kind = 'system' and jsonb_typeof(m.meta->'accountId') = 'string'
            then replace(m.body, '{account}',

            -- 줄이 네 가지를 말할 재료(#488 C2): 누가 · 무슨 말 · 무엇을 · 언제·어디.
            -- 이미 message 를 join 하고 있었으므로 컬럼만 더한다 — 새 왕복이 없다.
            -- 시스템 메시지의 자리표시자는 여기서 채운다 — 인박스 항목에는 kind 가 없어 화면이 못 채운다.
            m.author_id as "authorId", left(case when m.kind = 'system' and jsonb_typeof(m.meta->'accountId') = 'string'
            then replace(m.body, '{account}',
                         coalesce((select sa.handle from account sa where sa.id = (CASE WHEN (m.meta->>'accountId') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (m.meta->>'accountId')::uuid END)),
                                  '알 수 없음'))
            else m.body end, 500) as body,
            length(case when m.kind = 'system' and jsonb_typeof(m.meta->'accountId') = 'string'
            then replace(m.body, '{account}',
                         coalesce((select sa.handle from account sa where sa.id = (CASE WHEN (m.meta->>'accountId') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (m.meta->>'accountId')::uuid END)),
                                  '알 수 없음'))
            else m.body end) > 500 as "bodyTruncated", m.meta,
            -- 시스템 줄인가(시스템 줄 C안 c4) — 화면이 author 이름을 앞에 달지 않게 한다.
            m.kind,
            m.created_at as "createdAt", m.thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
            -- 팀 부름의 팀(047). 명단은 아래에서 한 번에 채운다 — 여기서 join 하면
            -- 팀원 수만큼 행이 불어나 항목이 여러 번 나온다.
            i.team_id as "teamId",
            -- 수정으로 생긴 부름(076). 참일 때만 싣는다 — 아래에서 거짓은 키째 지운다.
            i.via_edit as "viaEdit"
     from inbox i join message m on m.id = i.message_id
     join channel c on c.id = m.channel_id
     -- 지워진 말은 인박스에도 남지 않는다. 본문을 싣기 시작했으므로 이 조건이 없으면
     -- 지운 글이 인박스 줄에 그대로 보인다(전에는 id 만 실어 보이지 않았다).
     --
     -- **지금 볼 수 있는 채널의 것만**(2026-10-02, #1018 security F1 후속). 항목은 부를 때의
     -- 가시성으로 만들어지고 그 뒤로 남는다 — 비공개 채널에서 내보내지거나(removeChannelMember
     -- 는 inbox 행을 안 지운다) 채널이 비공개로 바뀌어도 그대로다. 거르지 않으면 나간 사람이
     -- 그 채널의 본문을 인박스로 계속 받는다. 행은 지우지 않는다: 다시 들어오면 다시 보인다.
     --
     -- 러너의 inbox.poll 도 이 함수를 쓴다 → 나간 채널의 부름으로는 **턴이 뜨지 않는다**.
     -- 의도다: 그 턴은 그 채널을 읽지도 거기에 쓰지도 못한다.
     where i.account_id = $1::uuid and m.deleted_at is null
       and ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = $1::uuid))
       
       and i.id in (
       select r.id from (
         select i2.id,
                row_number() over (partition by coalesce(m2.thread_root_id, m2.id)
                                   order by m2.created_at desc, i2.id desc) as rn,
                row_number() over (partition by coalesce(m2.thread_root_id, m2.id), i2.reason
                                   order by m2.created_at desc, i2.id desc) as rr,
                (m2.meta->>'kind' = 'failure'
                  or (m2.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
                      and m2.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' is null
                      and m2.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' is null)) as pinned
           from inbox i2 join message m2 on m2.id = i2.message_id
          where i2.account_id = $1::uuid and m2.deleted_at is null) r
        where r.rn <= 5 or r.rr = 1 or r.pinned)
       
       
       
     order by i.id
inbox_team_roster:
select t.id, t.name, tm.agent_account_id as "accountId", a.handle,
              nullif(split_part(coalesce(ac.instructions, ''), E'
', 1), '') as specialty,
              a.disabled_at is not null as disabled
         from agent_team t
         join agent_team_member tm on tm.team_id = t.id
         join account a on a.id = tm.agent_account_id
         left join agent_config ac on ac.account_id = a.id
        where t.id = any($1::uuid[])
        order by a.handle
inbox_handed:
select d.message_id, a.handle as "leadHandle", t.name as "teamName",
              d.deadline_at as "deadlineAt"
         from team_delegation d
         join account a on a.id = d.lead_account_id
         left join agent_team t on t.id = d.team_id
        where d.message_id = any($1::uuid[])
inbox_folded_wakes:
select w.canceled_by_message_id as by, wm.body as reason, w.wake_at as "wakeAt",
              wm.meta->'wake'->'reportTo' as "reportTo"
         from agent_wake w join message wm on wm.id = w.message_id
        where w.account_id = $1::uuid and w.canceled_by_message_id = any($2::uuid[])
        order by w.wake_at
inbox_started_in:
select m.id as "messageId", d.channel_id as "channelId", d.thread_root_id as "threadRootId"
         from message m
         join account a on a.id = m.author_id and a.kind = 'agent'
         join mandate d on d.id = coalesce(m.mandate_id,
                (select w.mandate_id from agent_wake w where w.message_id = m.id and w.account_id = $1::uuid
                  order by w.created_at desc limit 1))
         join agent_config me on me.account_id = $1::uuid and me.owner_account_id = d.owner_account_id
         join message r on r.id = d.root_message_id and r.deleted_at is null
         join channel sc on sc.id = d.channel_id
        where m.id = any($2::uuid[])
          and d.thread_root_id is not null and d.ended_at is null
          and d.thread_root_id <> coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id)
          and exists (select 1 from inbox hi
                        join message h on h.id = hi.message_id
                        join account ha on ha.id = h.author_id and ha.kind = 'human'
                       where hi.account_id = $1::uuid and h.deleted_at is null
                         and h.channel_id = d.channel_id and coalesce(h.thread_root_id, h.id) = d.thread_root_id)
          and ((sc.kind = 'standard' and sc.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = sc.id and cm_vis.account_id = $1::uuid))
inbox_delegation_outcomes:
select d.message_id, d.thread_root_id, d.lead_account_id, a.handle, i.outcome
       from team_delegation d
       join team_delegation_item i on i.delegation_id = d.id
       join account a on a.id = i.delegate_account_id
      where d.message_id = any($1::uuid[])
      order by a.handle
inbox_delegation_summaries:
select * from (
       select d.id, d.thread_root_id, d.kind, la.handle as delegator_handle, d.message_id, d.plan_step_id,
              d.lead_account_id = $1::uuid as is_lead,
              row_number() over (partition by d.thread_root_id order by d.created_at desc) as rn
         from team_delegation d
         join account la on la.id = d.lead_account_id
        where d.thread_root_id = any($2::uuid[])
          and (d.lead_account_id = $1::uuid
               or exists (select 1 from team_delegation_item i where i.delegation_id = d.id and i.delegate_account_id = $1::uuid))
     ) x where rn <= $3
     order by thread_root_id, rn desc
inbox_delegation_summary_items:
select i.delegation_id, i.delegate_account_id, a.handle, i.outcome, i.closed_reason, i.last_activity_at,
            (select m.id from message m
              where m.thread_root_id = d.thread_root_id and m.author_id = i.delegate_account_id and m.created_at >= d.created_at
              order by m.created_at desc limit 1) as last_message_id
       from team_delegation_item i
       join team_delegation d on d.id = i.delegation_id
       join account a on a.id = i.delegate_account_id
      where i.delegation_id = any($1::uuid[])
      order by a.handle
inbox_delegation_summary_watches:
select s.delegation_id, s.account_id, w.repo, w.number, w.head, w.until, a.handle
       from pr_watch_subscriber s
       join pr_watch w on w.id = s.watch_id and w.state = 'open'
       join account a on a.id = s.account_id
      where s.delegation_id = any($1::uuid[])
      order by w.created_at
inbox_thread_heads:
select m.id, m.seq::int as seq, m.channel_id as "channelId", m.thread_root_id as "threadRootId",
  m.author_id as "authorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then m.body else '' end as body,
  m.kind, case when m.deleted_at is null then m.meta else '{}'::jsonb end as meta,
  m.created_at as "createdAt",
  m.edited_at as "editedAt",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg(json_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'accountIds', r."accountIds") order by r."firstAt")
  from (
    select emoji, array_agg(account_id::text order by created_at) as "accountIds",
           min(created_at) as "firstAt"
    from message_reaction where message_id = m.id group by emoji
  ) r
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as reactions,
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (coalesce((
  select json_agg((jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'filename', a.filename,
    'contentType', a.content_type, 'sizeBytes', a.size_bytes::int
  ) || coalesce((
    select jsonb_build_object('artifact', jsonb_build_object(
      'artifactId', av.artifact_id, 'version', av.version, 'title', coalesce(av.title, ar.title), 'latestTitle', ar.title, 'summary', av.summary,
      'coverAttachmentId', av.cover_attachment_id,
      'latestVersion', (select max(av2.version) from artifact_version av2 where av2.artifact_id = av.artifact_id)))
    from artifact_version av join artifact ar on ar.id = av.artifact_id where av.attachment_id = a.id
  ), '{}'::jsonb)) order by a.attached_at, a.created_at)
  from attachment a where a.message_id = m.id
), '[]'::json)) else '[]'::json end as attachments,
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.reply_count end as "replyCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.activity_count end as "activityCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.last_reply_at end as "lastReplyAt",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_stats.participant_ids end as "participantIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.open_ask_human_count end as "openAskHumanCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.open_ask_account_ids end as "openAskAccountIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.open_gate_account_ids end as "openGateAccountIds",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.failure_count end as "failureCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_open.unresolved_failure_count end as "unresolvedFailureCount",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_state.open_ask_links end as "openAskLinks",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_last.last_kind end as "lastKind",
  case when m.thread_root_id is null then thread_last.last_author_id end as "lastAuthorId",
  case when m.deleted_at is null then (select json_build_object('status', ts.status, 'emoji', ts.emoji, 'accountId', ts.account_id,
    'reason', ts.reason, 'updatedAt', ts.updated_at) from thread_status ts where ts.root_id = m.id) end as "statusReaction",
  m.also_in_channel as "alsoInChannel", m.deleted_at as "deletedAt" from message m LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kind NOT IN ('progress', 'wake'))::int as reply_count,
    COUNT(*)::int as activity_count,
    MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE kind NOT IN ('progress', 'wake'))::text as last_reply_at,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(author_id ORDER BY last_at DESC)
      FROM (
        SELECT author_id, MAX(created_at) as last_at
        FROM message
        WHERE thread_root_id = m.id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND author_id IS NOT NULL
          -- 시스템 줄의 author 는 참여자가 아니다(시스템 줄 C안 c3) — 승인 글을 쓴 사람·알림 대상 에이전트일 뿐이다.
          AND kind <> 'system'
          AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
        GROUP BY author_id
      ) recent
    ), '{}'::uuid[]) as participant_ids
  FROM message WHERE thread_root_id = m.id AND deleted_at IS NULL
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_stats ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    -- 특정 계정에게 간 미답 물음의 수신자들. 화면이 "이것이 내 차례인가"를 여기서 가른다.
    COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId') FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' IS NOT NULL
    ), '{}'::text[]) as open_ask_account_ids,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure')::int as failure_count,
    -- 마디들: 누가 → 누구를 기다리는가(#488 A3-b). 위의 두 집계로는 부족하다 —
    -- open_ask_account_ids 는 '답해야 하는 쪽'만 모은 집합이라 누가 물었는지가
    -- 지워지고, 사슬을 이으려면 짝이 필요하다.
    --
    -- ARRAY_AGG 가 아니라 JSONB_AGG 인 이유가 그것이다: 두 값을 한 행으로 묶어
    -- 내보내야 짝이 유지된다. 배열 둘로 내면 순서가 같다는 보장이 없다.
    --
    -- 'human' 은 blockedBy = null 로 낸다 — 계정 id 로 대신 채우면 그 사람만
    -- 기다리는 것처럼 보인다(open_ask_human_count 를 따로 둔 것과 같은 이유).
    COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(
      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'waiter', t.author_id::text,
        'blockedBy', CASE WHEN t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
          THEN t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' END,
        'askedAt', t.created_at
      ) ORDER BY t.seq
    ) FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.author_id IS NOT NULL
        -- 사람 아무나(human)와 특정 계정(account) 둘 다 마디가 된다. 그 밖의
        -- to.kind 는 화면이 이을 수 없으므로 넣지 않는다.
        AND (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'human'
          OR (t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'account'
            AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'accountId' IS NOT NULL))
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
    -- 위임 마디(3-3). 팀장이 기다리는 팀원 하나마다 한 마디다.
    --
    -- 물음과 같은 목록에 넣는 이유: 사슬을 잇는 walk() 는 마디의 출처를 묻지 않는다 —
    -- 누가 누구를 기다리는가 하나만 본다. 목록을 갈라 두 벌로 내면 화면이 그 둘을 합치는
    -- 코드를 또 쓰게 되고, 그 합치기가 스레드 안(메시지에서 만든 사슬)과 갈라진다.
    --
    -- 위임 하나가 여러 마디가 되므로(팀원 N 명) jsonb_array_elements_text 로 펼친다.
    -- ask 는 상대가 하나라 그 펼침이 없었고, 그래서 별도 집계가 필요하다.
    || COALESCE((
      SELECT JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('waiter', d.author_id::text, 'blockedBy', o.id, 'askedAt', d.created_at)
        ORDER BY d.seq
      )
      FROM message d, LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(d.meta->'delegation'->'open') AS o(id)
      WHERE (d.id = m.id OR d.thread_root_id = m.id) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND d.meta->>'kind' = 'delegation' AND d.author_id IS NOT NULL
        AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
    ), '[]'::jsonb) as open_ask_links
  FROM message t
  WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_state ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  -- **묶음·실패 판정은 후보 행에서만 센다**(2026-10-24, JIT 문턱). 아래 셋은 행마다 하위 질의(묶음 색인·뒤에 말이 있는가)를
  -- 부른다. 위 집계의 FILTER 안에 두면 CASE 덕에 실제로는 후보 행에서만 돌지만, 플래너는 그 비용을 스레드의 **모든 행**에
  -- 매긴다 — 머리 한 행이 수천~수만이 되어 목록 쿼리 하나가 jit_above_cost 를 몇십 배 넘었고, 실행 6ms 쿼리가 JIT 컴파일로
  -- 5초를 썼다(운영 측정, 스레드 답글 339). 종류 조건을 스캔의 WHERE 로 내리면 그 하위 질의는 걸러진 행 수만큼만 매겨진다.
  -- 뜻은 같다: 셋 다 kind 가 ask·askBundle·failure 가 아닌 행에서는 원래 FILTER 가 거짓이었다.
  SELECT
    -- 사람 아무나에게 간 미답 물음의 수. 누구인지 물을 수 없으므로 수로만 낸다.
    -- **closedAt 도 닫는다**(2026-09-09). 답하지 않기로 한 물음은 열려 있지 않다 — 이
    -- 조건이 없으면 사람이 그만두기로 한 뒤에도 대기 줄과 '내 차례' 배지가 남는다. 같은
    -- 판정이 shared::isAskOpen 에 있다(SQL 은 그 함수를 부를 수 없어 다시 적는다) —
    -- **필드가 늘면 두 자리를 함께 고친다.**
    -- **묶음 카드는 묶음 하나에 한 번 센다**(선택 카드 P1 3c, 2026-10-11). 묶음에 담긴 원본은 원 스레드에서 세지
    -- 않고, 열린 줄을 가진 묶음 카드가 그 묶음 스레드에서 하나로 선다 — 같은 결정이 🙋·Inbox 에 두 번 서지 않게.
    -- 판정은 askBundleSql.ts 하나(threadStatus 의 FACTS_SQL 과 같은 조각).
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask'
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL
        AND t.meta->'ask'->'to'->>'kind' = 'human'
        AND NOT (CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'ask' THEN (
        NOT (t.meta ? 'permissionRequest' OR t.meta ? 'mergeDenial')
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message bnd
            JOIN channel bc ON bc.id = bnd.channel_id
           WHERE bnd.meta->>'kind' = 'askBundle' AND bnd.deleted_at IS NULL
             AND bc.kind = 'standard' AND bc.visibility = 'public' AND bc.archived_at IS NULL
             AND bnd.meta->'askBundle'->'items' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('rootId', t.id::text)))) ELSE false END)
    ) + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'askBundle' THEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM message br
         WHERE br.id = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE
            WHEN bi->>'rootId' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
            THEN (bi->>'rootId')::uuid END
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.meta->'askBundle'->'items') bi))
           AND br.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND br.meta->'ask'->>'answeredWith' IS NULL
           AND br.meta->'ask'->>'closedAt' IS NULL) ELSE false END)))::int as open_ask_human_count,
    -- **안 풀린** 실패만 따로 센다. 위의 누적 개수로 '막힘'을 칠하면 한 번 실패한 스레드는
    -- 그 뒤에 에이전트가 다시 붙어 진행 설명을 올리고 있어도 영원히 붉게 남는다 — 사람이
    -- 보는 화면에서 "작업 중"이 계속 "막힘"으로 뒤집히던 것이 이것이다.
    --
    -- 해소의 정의: **그 실패보다 뒤에 에이전트의 말이 있으면 풀린 것이다.** 에이전트의
    -- 말이란 (a) 진행 설명·대기 줄(kind), (b) 완료 보고(meta.kind), (c) **그 실패를 낸
    -- 계정 자신의 아무 말**이다. (c) 가 필요한 이유는 마지막 답을 평범한 글로 내는 러너가
    -- 있어서고, 그때 그 계정이 에이전트라는 것은 실패를 낸 자가 그 계정이라는 사실이
    -- 이미 말해 준다 — account 를 조인하지 않고도 안다.
    --
    -- 사람이 되묻는 말은 풀지 않는다. 그때는 정말로 막혀 있는 것이고, 그것을 '끝남'으로
    -- 칠하는 것이 이 필드가 막으려는 반대쪽 거짓말이다.
    --
    -- **CASE 로 감싼다**(2026-10-13 쿼리 개선 Q1). 집계의 FILTER 안 AND 는 적힌 순서대로 끊기지 않아, 이 하위 질의가
    -- 실패가 아닌 행에서도 돌았다 — 보드 머리 한 번에 스레드의 모든 행만큼(로컬 17,543번·11.5만 블록). CASE 는 평가 순서를
    -- 약속한다. 아래 open_gate_account_ids 도 같다.
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure' THEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message r
          WHERE (r.id = m.id OR r.thread_root_id = m.id)
            AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND r.seq > t.seq
            AND (r.kind IN ('progress', 'wake')
              OR r.meta->>'kind' = 'report'
              OR r.author_id = t.author_id)
        ) ELSE false END
    )::int as unresolved_failure_count,
    -- 안 풀린 account_gate 실패의 차례 주인들(2026-10-02). 해소 규칙은 바로 위와 **같다** —
    -- 갈라지면 🙋 가 풀린 뒤에도 Inbox 의 내 차례에 남는다. 차례 주인을 못 정한 실패
    -- (awaitingAccountId 없음)는 넣지 않는다: 아무 계정 id 로 채우면 그 사람만 강조를 받는다.
    COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.meta->'failure'->>'awaitingAccountId') FILTER (
      WHERE CASE WHEN t.meta->>'kind' = 'failure'
        AND t.meta->'failure'->>'code' = 'account_gate'
        AND t.meta->'failure'->>'awaitingAccountId' IS NOT NULL
        THEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM message r
          WHERE (r.id = m.id OR r.thread_root_id = m.id)
            AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND r.seq > t.seq
            AND (r.kind IN ('progress', 'wake')
              OR r.meta->>'kind' = 'report'
              OR r.author_id = t.author_id)
        ) ELSE false END
    ), '{}'::text[]) as open_gate_account_ids
  FROM message t
  WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND t.meta->>'kind' IN ('ask', 'askBundle', 'failure')
    -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
    AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
) thread_open ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  -- 마지막 말 하나. 그것이 진행이고 저자가 살아 있는 에이전트일 때만 '도는 중'이므로,
  -- 화면은 이 둘(kind·저자)에 자기가 아는 생존을 곱해 판정한다.
  --
  -- 「가장 최근의 살아 있는 답글」과 「루트 자신」 둘 중 seq 가 큰 것이다(2026-10-13 쿼리 개선 Q4). 예전 꼴
  -- WHERE (t.id = m.id OR t.thread_root_id = m.id) ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1 은 OR 때문에 색인 순서를 못 써서
  -- 스레드 전체를 모아 정렬했다(답글 2,600개 스레드면 2,600행 정렬). 답글 쪽은 (thread_root_id, seq) 색인을
  -- 거꾸로 한 줄만 읽고, 루트는 이미 손에 있는 m 이다. 둘을 seq 로 견주므로 뜻은 같다.
  SELECT x.kind as last_kind, x.author_id as last_author_id
  FROM (
    (SELECT t.kind, t.author_id::text as author_id, t.seq
       FROM message t
      WHERE t.thread_root_id = m.id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
        -- 시스템 줄은 누구의 말도 아니다 — 「마지막 말」에서 뺀다(시스템 줄 C안 c3).
        AND t.kind <> 'system'
        -- 루트에서만 계산한다 — 근거는 THREAD_STATS 위 주석.
        AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL
      ORDER BY t.seq DESC LIMIT 1)
    UNION ALL
    (SELECT m.kind, m.author_id::text, m.seq
      WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.thread_root_id IS NULL)
  ) x
  ORDER BY x.seq DESC LIMIT 1
) thread_last ON true
       join channel c on c.id = m.channel_id
      where m.id = any($1::uuid[]) and m.thread_root_id is null and (m.deleted_at is null or (m.thread_root_id is null and exists (
  select 1 from message r
   where r.thread_root_id = m.id and r.deleted_at is null
     and r.kind not in ('progress', 'wake')
)))
        and ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = $2::uuid))
      order by m.seq
inbox_thread_states:
select s.root_id as "rootId", s.state, s.until, s.updated_at as "updatedAt"
       from inbox_thread_state s
       join message m on m.id = s.root_id
       join channel c on c.id = m.channel_id
      where s.account_id = $1::uuid and s.root_id = any($2::uuid[]) and ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = $1::uuid))
      order by s.root_id
inbox_board_version:
with inb as materialized (
     select i.id, i.message_id, i.xmin::text as x from inbox i where i.account_id = $1::uuid
   ),
   roots as materialized (
     select coalesce(m.thread_root_id, m.id) as id from inb join message m on m.id = inb.message_id
     union
     select ts.root_id from (
       select distinct coalesce(said.thread_root_id, said.id) as root_id
         from message said
        where said.author_id = $1::uuid and said.deleted_at is null
          and said.created_at > now() - make_interval(days => $2::int)
     ) mine join thread_status ts on ts.root_id = mine.root_id
   ),
   msgs as materialized (
     select m.id, m.xmin::text as x, m.channel_id from message m where m.id in (select id from roots)
     union all
     select m.id, m.xmin::text, m.channel_id from message m where m.thread_root_id in (select id from roots)
   )
   select concat_ws('|',
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(id::text || ':' || x, 0)), 0)::text from inb),
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(id::text, 0)), 0)::text from roots),
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(id::text || ':' || x, 0)), 0)::text from msgs),
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(r.message_id::text || r.account_id::text || r.emoji || ':' || r.xmin::text, 0)), 0)::text
        from message_reaction r where r.message_id in (select id from roots)),
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(a.id::text || ':' || a.xmin::text, 0)), 0)::text from attachment a where a.message_id in (select id from roots)),
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(ts.root_id::text || ':' || ts.xmin::text, 0)), 0)::text from thread_status ts where ts.root_id in (select id from roots)),
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(s.root_id::text || ':' || s.xmin::text, 0)), 0)::text from inbox_thread_state s where s.account_id = $1::uuid),
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(c.id::text || ':' || c.xmin::text, 0)), 0)::text from channel c where c.id in (select channel_id from msgs)),
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(cm.channel_id::text || ':' || cm.xmin::text, 0)), 0)::text from channel_member cm where cm.account_id = $1::uuid),
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(t.id::text || ':' || t.xmin::text, 0)), 0)::text from agent_team t),
     (select count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(bit_xor(hashtextextended(tm.team_id::text || tm.agent_account_id::text || ':' || tm.xmin::text, 0)), 0)::text from agent_team_member tm)
   ) as v
inbox_board_root_ids:
with mine as (
       select distinct coalesce(said.thread_root_id, said.id) as root_id
         from message said
        where said.author_id = $1::uuid and said.deleted_at is null
          and said.created_at > now() - make_interval(days => $2::int)
     )
     select ts.root_id as id
       from mine
       join thread_status ts on ts.root_id = mine.root_id
       join message m on m.id = ts.root_id
       join channel c on c.id = m.channel_id
      where m.thread_root_id is null and (m.deleted_at is null or (m.thread_root_id is null and exists (
  select 1 from message r
   where r.thread_root_id = m.id and r.deleted_at is null
     and r.kind not in ('progress', 'wake')
)))
        and ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = $1::uuid))
      order by ts.updated_at desc, ts.root_id
      limit $3::int + 1
delegate_lead_team:
select t.id::text as team_id, a.handle, a.id::text as account_id, a.disabled_at is not null as disabled
       from agent_team t
       join agent_team_member tm on tm.team_id = t.id
       join account a on a.id = tm.agent_account_id
      where t.lead_account_id = $1::uuid
delegate_targets:
select id::text as id, lower(handle) as handle, disabled_at is not null as disabled from account
      where kind = 'agent' and deleted_at is null and lower(handle) = any($1::text[])
delegate_rounds_used:
select p.i::int as i,
            (select count(*)::int
               from team_delegation d
              where d.thread_root_id = p.root
                and d.lead_account_id = p.lead
                and d.kind = 'delegate'
                and d.created_at > coalesce((
                  select max(m.created_at) from message m
                   join account a on a.id = m.author_id
                  where (m.thread_root_id = p.root or (m.id = p.root and m.thread_root_id is null))
                    and a.kind = 'human'
                    and m.deleted_at is null
                ), 'epoch'::timestamptz)) as n
       from unnest($1::uuid[], $2::uuid[]) with ordinality as p(root, lead, i)
delegate_supersede:
update team_delegation_item i
        set outcome = 'closed', closed_reason = 'superseded', closed_at = now(), update_pending_message_id = null
       from team_delegation d
      where d.id = i.delegation_id and d.thread_root_id = $1::uuid and i.delegate_account_id = $2::uuid
        and i.delegation_id <> $3::uuid and (i.outcome is null or i.outcome = 'reported')
      returning i.delegation_id::text
delegate_mark_settled_quietly:
update team_delegation d set notified_at = now()
      where d.id = any($1::uuid[]) and d.notified_at is null
        and not exists (select 1 from team_delegation_item i where i.delegation_id = d.id and i.outcome is null)
delegate_inbox_convert:
update inbox set reason = 'team_delegated', team_id = $3::uuid
        where account_id = $1::uuid and message_id = $2::uuid and reason = 'mention'
delegate_inbox_insert: insert into inbox (account_id, message_id, reason, team_id) values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'team_delegated', $3::uuid)
